items.title: CoreWeave財報報喜！AI雲端股大反攻 分析師卻提醒一大風險
items.title_en: CoreWeave Reports Strong Earnings! AI Cloud Stocks Rally, but Analysts Warn of a Major Risk
paras: 據《路透》周三(11日)報導，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁營收與融資策略調整，暫時緩解AI泡沫疑慮，股價上漲10%，帶動AI雲端股反彈。主要支持者輝達(NVDA-US)也漲5%，扭轉黃仁勳風波引發的連兩日跌勢。
CoreWeave上調全年營收預測，並表示，近期借款成本飆升後，將不再向無擔保債務市場籌資，現有合約產生的現金流足以支應當前及未來債務償付，回應市場對其舉債擴張的疑慮。
過去數周，投資人擔憂AI需求一旦放緩，仰賴負債擴建資料中心的業者將承受衝擊。民主黨上周期中選舉大勝，也增添監管變數，部分勝選者主張加強管制，甚至暫停新建資料中心，涵蓋德州等重要市場。
CoreWeave執行長Michael Intrator表示，審查趨嚴可能拖慢產業建設速度，但預期不會大幅改變公司擴張計畫或推升成本。
伯恩斯坦分析師Madison Rezaei團隊認為，這份財報幾乎符合最佳期待，營運數據強勁、融資疑慮獲得回應，策略也合理。不過，一旦AI算力供不應求的情況緩解，CoreWeave可能是最早且受創最重的業者之一。
投資時機錯配的風險已浮現。軟銀(9984-JP)周二針對美國資料中心設備的不可退還預付款認列37億美元減損，拖累第二季淨損達70億美元。
Nebius(NBIS-US)、Iren(IREN-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Applied Digital(APLD-US)盤前漲4.7%至11.8%。若漲勢維持，連同CoreWeave的雲端業者市值合計可望增加逾250億美元，輝達則約增2,100億美元。Nebius將於周四(12日)盤前公布財報。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Wednesday (the 11th), CoreWeave (CRWV-US) posted robust revenue and adjusted its financing strategy, temporarily easing concerns about an AI bubble. The stock rose 10%, sparking a rebound in AI cloud stocks. Its main backer Nvidia (NVDA-US) also gained 5%, reversing the two‑day decline triggered by the Jensen Huang controversy.

CoreWeave raised its full‑year revenue outlook and said that after a recent surge in borrowing costs it will no longer raise funds in the unsecured debt market. Cash flow from existing contracts is sufficient to cover current and future debt service, addressing market worries about debt‑driven expansion.

In recent weeks investors have feared that a slowdown in AI demand could hit companies that rely on debt‑financed data‑center builds. The Democrats’ big win in last week’s midterm elections adds regulatory uncertainty, as some winners are calling for tighter controls and even a pause on new data‑center construction in key markets such as Texas.
CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator said that tighter review could slow industry‑wide build‑out, but he does not expect it to materially alter the company’s expansion plans or drive up costs.

Bernstein analyst Madison Rezaei’s team believes the earnings almost met the best expectations, with strong operating metrics, financing concerns addressed, and a sensible strategy. However, if the shortage of AI compute power eases, CoreWeave could be one of the earliest and hardest‑hit players.

The risk of a timing mismatch in investment has already surfaced. SoftBank (9984-JP) on Tuesday recorded a $3.7 billion impairment on non‑refundable prepaid payments for U.S. data‑center equipment, dragging Q2 net loss to $7 billion.

Nebius (NBIS-US), Iren (IREN-US), Oracle (ORCL-US) and Applied Digital (APLD-US) were up 4.7% to 11.8% in pre‑market trading. If the rally holds, the combined market value of these cloud players plus CoreWeave could add more than $25 billion, while Nvidia could gain about $210 billion. Nebius will release its earnings in pre‑market trading on Thursday (the 12th).

items.title: 全民喊「純過日子」中國「雙11」不再創造奇蹟
items.title_en: Everyone Calls for “Simply Living”: China’s “Double 11” No Longer Creates Miracles
paras: 過去幾年，每年都能聽到「雙11」逐漸安靜的討論，今年情緒熱度降溫似乎格外明顯。
今年10月初，中國消費者王琪看上了一輛折疊自行車，想趁著秋天多去戶外騎行，但再過不到十天，「雙11」活動就要開始了。她思索再三後，還是決定直接拿下，日常大促就有立減折扣，好天氣與秋色可不等人。
到了「雙11」最後幾天，她又看了看價格，發現到手價與「雙11」比起來差距只有人民幣幾十塊錢，她很滿意自己的選擇。
《界面新聞》11日（周三）指出，全民喊進入「純過日子」時代後，斷捨離、精簡生活、低成本自律的「喝大水」理論越來越火，還有像王琪這樣的情緒消費，也要追求即刻滿足。消費者越難越被定義，「雙11」氛圍也變了。
「純過日子」是2026年下半年在中國社群網路上爆紅的流行語，指的是一種不追排場、不搞儀式感、告別無謂內耗的生活態度。
社交平台上，大家仍然討論著十年前11月11號零點一到，所有人盯著螢幕搶五折，付款頁卡頓，伺服器直接被擠爆。那時候平台還會用實時大螢幕公布破億紀錄。
今年「雙11」溝通會上，還有記者問天貓總裁，「雙11」可能回到簡單粗暴五折時代嗎？可惜得到的答案是否定。
消費可以被創造，但奇蹟很難。不可否認，「雙11」仍然是一年中消費領域最重要的節點。
「雙11」不再是那個能憑空創造出銷量神話的節點，商家也在重新理解「雙11」。今天它更像一場期末考試，全年策略規劃都繞著「雙11」展開，考的也是商家品牌過去一年的決策。
paras_en: In recent years, the discussion around “Double 11” has been gradually quieting, and this year the drop in emotional intensity is especially noticeable.

In early October, Chinese consumer Wang Qi wanted a folding bike to ride outdoors in the autumn, but in less than ten days the “Double 11” event would begin. After much deliberation she decided to buy it outright, taking advantage of the everyday promotion discount, because good weather and autumn colors wait for no one.
During the final days of “Double 11” she checked the price again and found the final cost was only a few dozen yuan different from the “Double 11” price, leaving her very satisfied with her choice.

On Wednesday the 11th, Jiemian News noted that after the whole nation shouted about entering a “simply living” era, the “big water” theory of decluttering, simplifying life, and low‑cost self‑discipline has become increasingly popular, and emotional spending like Wang Qi’s also seeks instant gratification. Consumers are becoming harder to define, and the atmosphere of “Double 11” has changed.

“Simply living” is a buzzword that went viral on Chinese social networks in the second half of 2026, referring to a lifestyle attitude that avoids extravagance, ceremony, and pointless internal friction.

On social platforms people still reminisce about ten years ago, when at 00:00 on November 11 everyone stared at their screens to grab 50% off, payment pages lagged, and servers were overloaded. Back then platforms would display billion‑yuan sales records on real‑time big screens.
At this year’s “Double 11” briefing, a reporter asked Tmall’s CEO whether “Double 11” might return to the simple, brutal 50%‑off era. Unfortunately, the answer was negative.
Consumption can be created, but miracles are hard to achieve. It is undeniable that “Double 11” remains the most important consumption milestone of the year.

“Double 11” is no longer the point that can magically generate sales legends; merchants are re‑interpreting it. Today it resembles a final exam, with annual strategic planning revolving around “Double 11,” testing brands on the decisions they made over the past year.

items.title: 黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大！美國恐收緊輝達對中晶片出口管制、「3法案」通過機率飆升
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Affair Scandal Expands! U.S. Likely to Tighten Nvidia-China Chip Export Controls, "Three Bills" Passage Odds Surge
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳捲入婚外情及疑似中國情報人員相關風波，儘管輝達董事會已表態支持黃仁勳，美國國會跨黨派議員對他及輝達的信任卻出現動搖。分析指出，華府對此事的疑慮，預料將促使美國最快於下個月進一步收緊對輝達與中國業務往來的限制，國會議員也正準備舉行聽證會並展開調查。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，事實上，即使在間諜風波成為華府及華爾街焦點之前，針對中國取得部分輝達晶片的法案，就已經有機會透過年度國防法案在12月獲得國會通過。
多名分析師指出，如今這些法案透過這項「必須通過」的國防法案立法的可能性進一步提高。
Beacon Policy Advisors資深研究分析師Tedford指出，黃仁勳疑似涉及間諜事件，加上白宮承諾提出法案修正建議，使相關立法動能增強。不過，他認為法案仍非必然通過，即使最終獲得採納，內容也可能經過大幅調整，更接近白宮提出的版本。
目前受到關注的法案包括：

《晶片安全法案》（Chip Security Act），旨在遏止美國先進AI晶片遭非法走私至中國及其他敵對國家；
《AI監督法案》（AI Overwatch Act），則希望進一步收緊相關晶片的出口管制；
此外，《MATCH法案》也將針對敏感晶片製造設備加強出口限制。


報導指出，這些法案主要影響輝達，因為該公司掌握中國市場高度需求的最先進晶片。
上述三項法案都曾納入參議院今年稍早通過的國防授權法案版本，但未被眾議院版本採納。目前，參眾兩院協商代表正著手整合兩個版本的歧異，外界關注三項法案能否重新納入最終版本，讓國會兩院通過後，交由美國總統川普於下月簽署生效。
Veda Partners分析師Henrietta Treyz與Dan McCarthy指出，黃仁勳婚外情風波後，《晶片安全法案》立法機率已從原先的60%升至80%；《AI監督法案》從40%升至65%；《MATCH法案》則從35%提高至60%。
兩名分析師表示，接下來值得關注的是黃仁勳11月18日出席眾議院情報、外交事務及中國相關委員會閉門聽證會的情況，尤其是是否有證據顯示，川普政府的晶片與AI政策資訊曾洩漏給疑似中國情報人員、曾任新加坡雲端運算公司Megaspeed的高層黃樂（Alice Huang）。
至於川普政府是否進一步對輝達採取強硬措施，分析師認為可能性也有所上升，但幅度有限。最可能的做法是加強執法，打擊先進晶片走私至中國的行為。
另一種可能性較低的措施，是限制中國企業透過其他國家的資料中心遠端使用先進晶片。至於更激進的選項，包括撤銷輝達向中國出口H200晶片的許可，但分析師認為，考量川普與黃仁勳長期以來的關係，以及川普支持輝達發展的立場，短期內實施的可能性不高。
川普周一公開力挺黃仁勳，稱讚他「打造了一家很棒的公司」，並表示自己認為黃仁勳是非常正直的人，對他能妥善處理事件深具信心。川普也轉述，黃仁勳表示自己完全不知道相關人士是間諜。
輝達周日（8日）宣布，董事會正調查黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的鎖定目標。黃仁勳同日也在寄給員工的電子郵件中坦承對妻子不忠，並強調自己將致力於保護輝達及維護美國國家安全。
輝達股價周二（10日）下跌近6%，繼周一（9日）跌逾4%後持續走弱。今年以來股價累計下跌近10%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has become embroiled in an extramarital affair and alleged ties to Chinese intelligence operatives. Although Nvidia's board has voiced support for Huang, bipartisan members of the U.S. Congress are wavering in their trust of him and the company. Analysts say Washington's concerns are expected to prompt the United States to further tighten restrictions on Nvidia's dealings with China as early as next month, with lawmakers preparing hearings and investigations.

According to MarketWatch, even before the espionage scandal became a focus in Washington and on Wall Street, legislation aimed at restricting China's acquisition of certain Nvidia chips had a chance to pass Congress through the annual defense bill in December.
Several analysts note that the likelihood of these bills being enacted as part of the "must‑pass" defense legislation has now increased further.

Tedford, a senior research analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, said Huang's alleged involvement in an espionage incident, combined with the White House's pledge to propose amendments, has boosted legislative momentum. However, he cautioned that the bills are not guaranteed to pass and, even if adopted, could be substantially revised to align more closely with the White House's version.
The bills currently under scrutiny include:

The Chip Security Act, which aims to prevent advanced U.S. AI chips from being illegally smuggled to China and other hostile nations; the AI Overwatch Act, which seeks to tighten export controls on related chips; and the MATCH Act, which would tighten export restrictions on sensitive chip‑manufacturing equipment. The report notes that these measures primarily affect Nvidia, which holds the most advanced chips that are in high demand in the Chinese market.

All three proposals were incorporated into the version of the defense authorization bill that the Senate passed earlier this year, but were omitted from the House version. Lawmakers from both chambers are now working to reconcile the differences, and observers are watching to see whether the three bills will be re‑included in the final package that, if passed by both chambers, would be sent to President Trump for signing next month.

Veda Partners analysts Henrietta Treyz and Dan McCarthy said that after the affair scandal, the probability of the Chip Security Act being enacted rose from 60% to 80%; the AI Overwatch Act from 40% to 65%; and the MATCH Act from 35% to 60%.

The analysts added that attention will now turn to Huang's closed‑door testimony before the House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China committees on November 18, particularly whether evidence emerges that Trump administration chip and AI policy information was leaked to suspected Chinese intelligence operatives, including former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

As for whether the Trump administration will take tougher action against Nvidia, analysts say the likelihood has risen but any measures would be limited. The most probable step is increased enforcement to curb the smuggling of advanced chips to China.

A less likely option would be to restrict Chinese firms from remotely accessing advanced chips via data centers in other countries. A more aggressive possibility would be to revoke Nvidia's license to export H200 chips to China, but analysts note that, given Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Huang and his support for Nvidia’s growth, such a move is unlikely in the short term.

Trump publicly defended Huang on Monday, praising him for "building a great company" and saying he considers Huang a very upright person and is confident he can handle the situation properly. Trump also relayed that Huang said he had no knowledge that the individuals involved were spies.

Nvidia announced on Sunday (the 8th) that its board is investigating whether Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations. In an email to employees the same day, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and emphasized his commitment to protecting Nvidia and safeguarding U.S. national security.
Nvidia's shares fell nearly 6% on Tuesday (the 10th), extending a decline that saw the stock drop more than 4% on Monday (the 9th). The stock is down almost 10% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉CoreWeave財報助攻！那指領漲 台積電ADR漲逾4%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Rise Early: CoreWeave Earnings Boost; Nasdaq Leads, TSMC ADR Up Over 4%
paras: 美股主要指數周三(11日)開盤走高，那斯達克指數領漲。AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁財報提振市場對人工智慧(AI)需求的信心，暫時緩解投資人對支出過度擴張的疑慮，帶動科技股反彈。
輝達(NVDA-US)也在連續兩個交易日下跌後回升，市場重新押注，支撐美股多頭行情的AI投資熱潮仍有延續空間。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近90點或近0.2%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近410點或近1.6%，標普 500 指數漲近1.0%，費城半導體指數漲近4.3%，台積電ADR漲近4.1%。
CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁財報與Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)熱絡需求，帶動資金重返AI概念股，美股期貨走高。那斯達克100指數期貨上漲2%，標普500指數期貨上漲1%，但升息預期升溫，仍限制整體市場的上漲空間。

AI需求數據提振信心 CoreWeave盤前大漲15%

先前遭重挫的AI雲端業者CoreWeave公布強勁營收成長，緩解市場對其高負債營運模式的疑慮，盤前股價大漲15%，帶動Nebius(NBIS-US)等同業及AI基礎建設類股同步走高。輝達(NVDA-US)也有望迎來執行長黃仁勳風波爆發後的首個上漲交易日。
其他企業數據同樣顯示AI需求仍強。OpenAI單季營收首度達到100億美元；知情人士則透露，Anthropic的IPO認購訂單已達可供發售股數的數倍，為近期承壓的AI投資題材增添支撐。
美國期中選舉結果出爐後，AI類股一度面臨沉重賣壓。CoreWeave最新業績則顯示，即使資料中心產業面臨挑戰，營收仍維持強勁成長。
貝倫貝格銀行的Ulrich Urbahn表示，這波AI行情回升有實際需求作為依據：CoreWeave第三季業績優於預期，並上調全年展望。他指出，相關股票估值已明顯降低，促使投資人重新建立部位。
不過，IPO熱潮也引發估值疑慮。Anthropic預計最快於下周接近周末時開始交易，創投公司Copper Sky的Jack Selby警告，這場IPO可能成為AI行情大幅反轉的觸媒，日後閉鎖期屆滿、限售股解禁，也可能對股價形成壓力。
Selby接受《彭博》電視訪問時表示，AI業務極度仰賴資本支出，雖然確實存在商業價值，但仍處於發展初期，將Anthropic視為價值1兆美元的企業，在他看來過於牽強。

升息預期限制漲勢 油價回升與歐股走強

AI類股反彈之際，利率前景仍是市場阻力。升息預期升溫限制美股整體漲幅，美元上漲0.3%。美國公債現貨市場因退伍軍人節休市，但衍生性商品交易顯示，美債價格可能延續周二跌勢。
油價則止住連續兩天下跌，布蘭特原油回升至接近每桶93美元。伊朗一名高階官員排除放棄濃縮鈾的可能性，顯示美伊立場仍存在明顯分歧。
歐洲方面，科技與能源類股領漲，泛歐Stoxx 600指數上漲0.4%；區域公債價格也回升，以法國與義大利公債表現領先。根據《彭博》彙整數據，以美元計算，歐股基準指數本季迄今報酬率領先標普500逾3個百分點。
傑富瑞(JEF-US)的Mohit Kumar表示，相較美股，投資人目前仍低配歐股，偏低的持股比重可能提供後續支撐。他指出，該行正尋找科技題材以外的資金輪動機會，除了美國其他類股，也將投資分散至歐洲與新興市場。
Kumar補充，該行部位指標顯示，股票與信用市場部位均接近中性，這也是其看好風險性資產的原因之一。
《彭博》總體策略師Conor Cooper則認為，歐股朝歷史收盤新高邁進，企業財報與經濟前景仍提供支撐。聯準會(Fed)立場若更偏鷹派，也未必全然不利歐股，因為美元走強可能有利歐洲出口商。

paras_en: U.S. major indexes opened higher on Wednesday (the 11th), with the Nasdaq leading the gains. AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) posted a strong earnings report that lifted market confidence in AI demand and temporarily eased investors' concerns about over‑expansion of spending, sparking a rebound in tech stocks.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) also looked set for its first rally day since CEO Jensen Huang’s controversy erupted.

Other company data also showed that AI demand remains strong. OpenAI’s quarterly revenue topped $10 billion for the first time; sources said Anthropic’s IPO orders were several times the number of shares on offer, adding support to the AI investment theme that had been under pressure.

After the U.S. mid‑term election results were released, AI stocks faced heavy selling pressure. CoreWeave’s latest results showed that even as data‑center industry challenges persist, its revenue continued to grow strongly.

Ulrich Urbahn of Berenberg Bank said the AI rally is backed by real demand: CoreWeave’s third‑quarter results beat expectations and the company raised its full‑year outlook. He noted that valuations for related stocks have fallen markedly, prompting investors to rebuild positions.

However, the IPO frenzy also raises valuation concerns. Anthropic is expected to begin trading as early as next weekend. Jack Selby of venture firm Copper Sky warned that the IPO could become a catalyst for a sharp reversal in the AI rally, and that the eventual lock‑up expiry and share‑release could put downward pressure on the price.

In a Bloomberg TV interview, Selby said AI businesses are heavily reliant on capital spending. While there is genuine commercial value, the sector is still in its early stages, and valuing Anthropic at a $1 trillion enterprise is, in his view, overly optimistic.

Rising rate‑hike expectations are curbing the rally, while oil prices rebound and European stocks strengthen. Even as AI stocks bounce, the outlook for interest rates remains a market drag. Higher rate‑hike expectations are limiting overall U.S. equity gains, and the dollar rose 0.3%. Kumar further noted that the firm’s position indicators show its equity and credit exposures are near neutral, which is one reason it remains bullish on risk assets.

items.title: 迎戰「超高齡」與「單身」雙颱效應 單身族必學的高齡保險與資產三層防護網
items.title_en: Facing the Dual Typhoon of “Super‑Aging” and “Singlehood”: A Three‑Layer Protection Plan of Elderly Insurance and Asset Safeguards for Singles
paras: 台灣正迎向「超高齡」與「單身社會」的雙颱效應，隨著「1人戶」躍居社會主流，缺乏同住家屬支援的「一個人的老後」已成無法迴避的現實。當長壽不一定是祝福，專家呼籲，單身族群應及早透過醫療與長照、保險金安信託及意定監護等三重防線，緊密結合資金、信託與監護，才能在超高齡洪流中捍衛老後尊嚴與自主權。
這場人口結構的劇烈質變，可從兩項最新數據的「黃金交叉」中看出端倪。根據內政部資料統計，台灣未婚、離婚及喪偶人口佔總人口的比例，在1976至1996年間僅維持在四成左右；至2021年正式突破半數達50%後逐年攀升，2026 年已接近51%，單身比例續創新高。
無獨有偶，行政院主計總處最新公布的2025年家庭收支調查顯示，台灣「2 人以下家庭」占比首度過半、達 51.6%（其中 1 人家庭佔 17.33%、2 人家庭佔 34.27%）。最震撼的是，「1 人家庭」的比率首度超越了傳統的「4 人家庭」（16.63%）。這些數據在在宣告：缺乏同住家屬支援的「單身」與「超高齡」軌跡已完全重疊，「一個人的老後」已是全台灣無可迴避的共同未來。
單身最怕失能、失智。一位獨力扶養三個孩子的離婚女性小婉，在晚年不幸罹患失智症。雖然她及早規劃了失能險，但孩子們領取了理賠金後，卻不願將這筆錢花在她的醫療與照護上。最終，小婉只能輾轉在三個孩子間，成為彼此推託的燙手山芋。這印證了長壽不一定是祝福，有時更是一場對照護品質與人生自主權的嚴峻考驗。
針對高齡+單身兩大退休痛點，永達保經指出，單身者是自己唯一的經濟支柱，保險不僅是退路，更是尊嚴。針對不同狀態的單身族群，建議從健康狀態及資產狀態兩個層面分別進行精準規劃。
現在最怕的不是不夠活，而是太長壽卻無法自理。單有資金不夠，還需結合法律制度建構最完整的保護傘：

第一層「醫療與長照險」：應付住院與長期照護開銷，維持生活不失衡。
第二層「保險金安養信託」：將理賠金或資產交由銀行專款專用，按月支付醫療及養護機構，防堵資金被騙或遭親友挪用。
第三層「意定監護與預立醫療」：趁意識健全時，公證指定信任者（如親友或律師）擔任未來監護人，代為決策醫療與財務；並簽署預立醫療決定書、於聯徵中心申請金融註記，全面防範失智風險。


永達保經總經理特助吳柏瑨表示：「高質量的晚年生活絕非偶然，而是來自精準的規劃。當數據顯示『一人戶』已成社會主流，除了資產保全和財富傳承之外，我們呼籲準退休族應將財務思維放在『自我照顧』。資金是基礎、信託是執行、意定監護則是靈魂。及早將這三者緊密結合，單身者便能把未來的掌控權交回自己手中。透過專業保險經紀人客觀評估，啟動退休準備，並結合信託機制鎖住老本，這不僅是捍衛老後尊嚴，更是對自己打拚成果的最大負責。」
paras_en: Taiwan is confronting a dual‑typhoon effect of “super‑aging” and a “single society,” as one‑person households have become mainstream. The reality of “aging alone” without co‑habiting family support can no longer be avoided. When longevity is not always a blessing, experts urge single individuals to establish three defensive lines—medical and long‑term care insurance, insurance‑fund trust, and advance guardianship—tightly integrating capital, trusts and guardianship to protect dignity and autonomy in the wave of extreme old age.

This dramatic shift in population structure is evident from a “golden cross” of two recent data points. According to the Ministry of the Interior, the share of unmarried, divorced and widowed people in Taiwan’s total population stayed around 40 % from 1976 to 1996; after breaking the half‑mark at 50 % in 2021, it has risen each year, approaching 51 % in 2026, setting a new high for singlehood.

Similarly, the Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics released the 2025 Household Income and Expenditure Survey, showing that households of two people or fewer now account for a majority at 51.6 % (with one‑person households at 17.33 % and two‑person households at 34.27 %). Remarkably, the proportion of one‑person households has for the first time surpassed the traditional four‑person household (16.63 %). These figures declare that the trajectories of “single” and “super‑aging” without co‑habiting family support have fully overlapped, making “aging alone” an unavoidable common future for all of Taiwan.

Singles fear loss of function and dementia the most. A divorced woman, Xiao‑Wan, who raised three children on her own, later developed dementia. Although she had planned ahead with disability insurance, her children, after receiving the payout, refused to spend the money on her medical care and nursing. In the end, Xiao‑Wan was shuffled among her three children, becoming a burdensome hot‑potato. This illustrates that longevity is not always a blessing; sometimes it becomes a harsh test of care quality and personal autonomy.

Addressing the two major retirement pain points of age and singlehood, Yongda Insurance Brokerage points out that a single person is their own sole economic pillar, and insurance is not just a safety net but also a matter of dignity. For different single‑person profiles, they recommend precise planning based on health status and asset condition.

The biggest fear now is not a short life but an excessively long one without the ability to care for oneself. Having money alone is insufficient; one must also combine legal mechanisms to build the most complete protective umbrella:

First layer – “Medical and Long‑Term Care Insurance”: to cover hospitalization and long‑term care expenses and keep daily life balanced. Second layer – “Insurance‑Fund Elderly Care Trust”: to place claim payouts or assets in a bank‑managed dedicated fund that pays medical and nursing institutions monthly, preventing fraud or misuse by relatives or friends. Third layer – “Advance Guardianship and Advance Medical Directives”: while still of sound mind, notarize a trusted person (such as a relative or lawyer) as future guardian to decide on medical and financial matters; also sign an advance medical decision document and register a financial annotation with the credit‑information center to fully guard against dementia risk.

items.title: 美光看起來超便宜？高盛：挑記憶體股別只看本益比
items.title_en: Micron looks ultra cheap? Goldman Sachs: When selecting memory stocks, only look at the P/E ratio
paras: 美光(MU-US)股價歷經一個月重挫後，開始吸引逢低買盤，周三(11日)盤前上漲6.2%，報769.74美元。不過，高盛(GS-US)認為，近期記憶體股賣壓過後，南韓同業SK海力士(SKHY-US)(000660-KS)與三星電子(005930-KS)的估值更具吸引力，仍是該行較偏好的投資標的。
據《巴隆》報導，市場擔憂民主黨主導的資料中心反對聲浪可能拖慢人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮，美光過去一個月累計下跌21%。雖然股價修正使其預估本益比顯得相當便宜，但對於景氣循環明顯的記憶體產業，低本益比未必代表低估。
質疑者指出，記憶體公司在景氣高峰時獲利大增，往往會讓本益比看起來偏低；一旦景氣反轉、獲利大幅下滑，原先看似便宜的估值就可能失去支撐。因此，高盛分析師James Schneider及其團隊更偏好以股價相對「有形帳面價值」的倍數評估這個產業。
有形帳面價值是從帳面淨值中扣除商譽與其他無形資產後的數值，屬於較保守的資產衡量方式，可粗略用來評估公司清算後股東可能取得的剩餘價值，但不代表實際清算時一定能回收的金額。
Schneider在本周研究報告中指出，全球記憶體股過去往往在接近有形帳面價值時觸底，目前已有數家公司的估值開始接近這些水準，其中三星與SK海力士的股價已低於各自每股帳面淨值。不過，低於帳面淨值與低於扣除無形資產後的有形帳面價值，仍是不同概念。
高盛對SK海力士與三星均給予「買進」評等，但投資管道也會影響實際買進成本。以SK海力士為例，其美國存託憑證(ADR)周三上漲約8%，交易價格卻較南韓掛牌股票溢價逾40%，投資人若透過ADR布局，未必能取得與韓股相同的估值優勢。
相較之下，高盛估算，美光股價仍約為有形帳面價值的5.4倍，Schneider因此維持「中立」評等。不過，他給予的目標價仍高達1,250美元，顯示即使美光並非該行首選，仍被認為具有可觀的上漲空間。
Schneider表示，考量美光未來幾季極有可能產生強勁的自由現金流，該股的風險報酬已變得更具吸引力。高盛的立場因此並非全面看空美光，而是在記憶體股修正後，仍較看好三星與SK海力士的相對估值。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) stock price after a month of steep decline begins attracting buying on dips, up 6.2% pre‑market Wednesday (the 11th) at $769.74. However Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) believes that after recent selling pressure in memory stocks, South Korean peers SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) (000660‑KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS) have more attractive valuations and remain the firm’s preferred investment targets.

According to Barron’s, the market worries that Democrat‑led data‑center opposition could slow the AI investment boom, and Micron has fallen 21% over the past month. Although the price correction makes its forward P/E appear very cheap, for the clearly cyclical memory industry a low P/E does not necessarily indicate undervaluation.

Critics note that memory companies see profit surges at cyclical peaks, making P/E look low; once the cycle reverses and earnings drop sharply, the seemingly cheap valuation can lose support. Therefore Goldman analysts James Schneider and his team prefer evaluating the industry using the price multiple relative to tangible book value.

Tangible book value is the net book value after subtracting goodwill and other intangibles, a more conservative asset measure, roughly used to assess the residual value shareholders might obtain after liquidation, but it does not guarantee the actual recoverable amount in liquidation.

Schneider said in this week’s research report that global memory stocks have historically bottomed when approaching tangible book value; several companies are now near those levels, with Samsung and SK Hynix trading below their respective book value per share. However, being below book value and being below tangible book value after removing intangibles are different concepts.

Goldman gives “Buy” ratings to SK Hynix and Samsung, but investment channels affect actual purchase cost. For SK Hynix, its ADR rose about 8% on Wednesday, yet trades at a premium of over 40% to the Korean‑listed shares; investors using ADRs may not capture the same valuation advantage as with the Korean stock.

By contrast, Goldman estimates Micron’s price is still about 5.4 times its tangible book value, so Schneider maintains a “Neutral” rating. Nevertheless, his target price remains as high as $1,250, indicating that even though Micron is not the firm’s top pick, it is still seen as having considerable upside.

Schneider said that considering Micron could generate strong free cash flow in the coming quarters, the stock’s risk‑reward profile has become more attractive. Goldman’s stance is therefore not a blanket bearish view on Micron, but after the memory‑stock correction it still prefers the relative valuations of Samsung and SK Hynix.

items.title: 美中晶片管制現漏洞？《路透》揭中國軍方關聯大學取得輝達H200、A100等受限晶片
items.title_en: Is There a Loophole in US-China Chip Controls? Reuters Reveals Chinese Military‑Linked Universities Obtaining Restricted Nvidia H200, A100 and Other Chips
paras: 中國人民解放軍關係密切的西北工業大學，儘管早已被美國列入出口管制黑名單，仍透過中國本土供應商，在上個月購入輝達(NVDA-US) 高階AI晶片H200，交易金額達87.47萬元人民幣（約12.3萬美元），凸顯華府試圖限制中國取得先進科技的措施仍存在漏洞。
根據《路透》報導，根據西北工業大學官網10月21日公布的採購紀錄，這所被列入中國「國防七子」的國防領域重點大學，上個月以87.47萬元人民幣（約12.3萬美元）購入兩顆H200晶片。
採購紀錄顯示，這批晶片是由該校管理學院向陝西博算網路科技公司購入，而非直接向輝達採購。
H200是輝達性能最強大的AI晶片之一，可用於訓練及執行先進AI系統，出口須取得美國政府許可。對於西北工業大學這類遭列入黑名單的機構，美國通常會拒絕核發相關出口許可。
採購紀錄也顯示，西北工業大學今年透過與中國企業簽訂的五份運算資源租用合約，取得H200及其他高效能輝達AI處理器的使用權。
這項調查結果出爐之際，輝達及執行長黃仁勳正面臨華府日益升高的審查壓力。此前有報導指黃仁勳遭中國間諜行動鎖定，加上他持續遊說美國放寬對中AI晶片銷售限制，使相關爭議進一步升溫。
黃仁勳主張，持續向中國銷售美國晶片，有助於維持美國的技術領先地位，也能讓中國客戶繼續依賴美國技術。
不過，美國部分國會議員認為，讓中國取得輝達最強大的AI晶片，可能加速中國將AI應用於武器設計、情報分析及軍事現代化。
美國國會民主、共和兩黨議員均呼籲加強管制中國取得先進AI晶片，包括要求追蹤晶片流向，以及提高國會對晶片出口的監督力度。三名共和黨籍國會委員會主席已要求黃仁勳於11月18日出席簡報會，說明他據報與一名涉嫌中國情報人員的接觸情況。

中國西北工業大學被列入美國貿易黑名單

西北工業大學位於中國西北部城市西安，研究領域涉及軍用飛機、飛彈及衛星。
美國商務部2001年以該校涉嫌參與飛彈擴散活動及軍事研究為由，將其列入貿易黑名單「實體清單」。2019年，美國進一步收緊限制，規定向該校出口受管制的美國技術，在大多數情況下均採取拒絕核發許可的政策。
《路透》指出，西北工業大學的採購情況表明，與中國軍方有關聯的機構，仍能透過本土供應商取得美國AI運算能力，不論是直接購買晶片，或租用搭載相關晶片的伺服器。
此外，《路透》檢視今年中國26份政府採購及企業紀錄發現，多所大學與研究機構透過本土供應商購買受到美國出口限制的輝達晶片，或租用採用這些晶片的輝達運算服務，其中數所機構與中國國防產業或軍事研究關係密切。

黑名單大學仍取得多款受限晶片運算資源

美國總統川普政府今年1月開始，逐案批准部分H200晶片出口至中國，但這項政策並未解除實體清單機構所面臨的獨立限制，西北工業大學仍在適用範圍內。
1月公布的出口許可規定，也要求採取防護措施，避免遭列入黑名單的機構及軍事終端用戶，透過遠端方式使用依照該政策出口的晶片。相關政策涵蓋H200及性能較低的其他型號。
除了管理學院直接購入兩顆H200晶片，採購紀錄還顯示，西北工業大學網路空間安全學院今年1月決標兩份為期7個月的合約，租用搭載H200晶片的伺服器，每台伺服器各包含8顆H200。兩份合約金額分別為44.17萬元及44.1萬元人民幣，服務用途包括AI模型微調及強化學習訓練。
同時，該校也租用了搭載8顆輝達A100晶片及8顆A800晶片的伺服器。A100與A800均禁止出口至中國任何實體，不過，H200仍是西北工業大學採購紀錄中提及的性能最先進晶片。
今年4月，西北工業大學內另一所研究機構也以37.5萬元人民幣採購運算服務，合約要求至少提供24顆A100晶片，用於結構力學及流體動力學模擬。
這些合約由數家知名度不高的中國科技供應商得標，但採購紀錄幾乎沒有提供晶片來源，以及租用伺服器實際運作地點的資訊。
根據中國法律，政府採購機構必須在公布得標廠商及簽訂合約前，確認供應商有能力履行訂單。

受限輝達晶片在中國大學市場持續流通

採購紀錄也顯示，受美國出口限制的輝達AI晶片及運算服務，在中國大學市場形成更廣泛的供應管道。
深圳大學9月以76.98萬元人民幣購入3顆H100晶片，這款高階AI晶片同樣遭美國禁止出口至中國。武漢理工大學則在6月以35.5萬元人民幣購入一台搭載H100晶片的伺服器，另外也以34.4萬元人民幣採購4顆A100晶片。
同屬中國「國防七子」的北京航空航天大學，今年4月以48.9萬元人民幣購入4顆A800處理器。北京航空航天大學與中國航空航太及國防產業關係密切，研究工作涉及軍用航空及太空計畫。
另外，中國科學院大學7月及9月公布的兩份政府採購公告，列出獲選提供運算服務的供應商，相關服務使用遭美國限制出口至中國的輝達H800及A800晶片。其中一份公告列出的H800運算服務價格為每顆晶片每小時10元人民幣。
另一份今年1月的採購決標公告則列出一家供應商，將向深圳一所公共機構提供6顆A100晶片，合約金額為48.48萬元人民幣。
《路透》先前也曾報導，中國機構透過本土經銷商，取得搭載於美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 、戴爾科技(DELL-US) 及技嘉(2376-TW) 伺服器中的受限輝達晶片。
此外，該媒體也曾揭露中國存在受限輝達晶片的地下交易市場，貨源來自海外庫存及第三國中間商。
paras_en: Northwest University of Technology, a school closely tied to the People’s Liberation Army and already on the US export‑control blacklist, still bought Nvidia (NVDA-US) high‑end AI chip H200 last month through a domestic Chinese supplier for 874,700 yuan (about $123,000), highlighting gaps in Washington’s attempts to curb China’s access to advanced technology.

According to Reuters, the procurement record posted on Northwest University of Technology’s website on October 21 shows that the university, listed among China’s “Seven Defense Sons” and a key institution in the defence sector, purchased two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan (about $123,000).
The record indicates the chips were bought by the university’s School of Management from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology Co., not directly from Nvidia.

The H200 is one of Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips, usable for training and running advanced AI systems, and its export requires US government approval. For entities like Northwest University of Technology that are on the blacklist, the US typically denies such export licences.

The procurement data also shows that this year the university secured usage rights to the H200 and other high‑performance Nvidia AI processors through five computing‑resource lease contracts signed with Chinese firms.

The findings emerge as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny from Washington. Earlier reports said Huang was targeted by Chinese espionage efforts and that his lobbying for looser US AI‑chip sales restrictions to China has intensified the controversy.
Huang argues that continued sales of US chips to China help maintain America’s technological lead and keep Chinese customers dependent on US technology.
However, some US lawmakers warn that letting China obtain Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips could accelerate the use of AI in weapons design, intelligence analysis and military modernisation.

Democratic and Republican members of Congress alike are calling for tighter controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, including tracking chip flows and strengthening congressional oversight of chip exports. Three Republican committee chairs have asked Huang to appear at a briefing on November 18 to explain reports of his contact with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.
Northwest University of Technology is on the US trade blacklist. The university, located in Xi’an in north‑western China, conducts research on military aircraft, missiles and satellites.

The US Department of Commerce added the school to the Entity List in 2001 over alleged involvement in missile proliferation and military research. In 2019 the US tightened restrictions, generally refusing licences for exporting controlled US technology to the school.

Reuters notes that the university’s purchases show that institutions linked to the Chinese military can still obtain US AI computing power via domestic suppliers, whether by buying chips outright or leasing servers equipped with them.

Reuters also examined 26 Chinese government and corporate procurement records this year and found that many universities and research institutes bought restricted Nvidia chips or leased Nvidia computing services through local vendors, with several of those entities closely tied to China’s defence industry or military research.

Blacklist‑listed universities have still obtained multiple restricted‑chip computing resources. The Trump administration began approving case‑by‑case exports of some H200 chips to China in January, but the policy did not lift the separate restrictions that apply to Entity‑List entities, so Northwest University of Technology remained subject to them.

The January export‑licence rules also required protective measures to prevent blacklisted entities and military end‑users from remotely accessing chips exported under the policy. The rules cover the H200 and lower‑performance models as well.

Beyond the School of Management’s direct purchase of two H200 chips, the procurement record shows that the university’s School of Cyberspace Security awarded two seven‑month contracts in January to lease servers equipped with H200 chips, each server containing eight H200s. The contracts were valued at 441,700 yuan and 441,000 yuan respectively, for AI model fine‑tuning and reinforcement‑learning training.

At the same time, the university also leased servers equipped with eight Nvidia A100 chips and eight A800 chips. Both the A100 and A800 are prohibited from export to any entity in China, yet the H200 remains the most advanced chip mentioned in the university’s procurement records.

In April, another research institute within Northwest University of Technology bought computing services for 375,000 yuan, with the contract requiring at least 24 A100 chips for structural mechanics and fluid‑dynamics simulations.

These contracts were awarded to several little‑known Chinese tech suppliers, but the procurement records provide little information about the chips’ origin or the physical location of the leased servers.
Under Chinese law, government‑procurement agencies must verify a supplier’s ability to fulfil an order before publishing the winning vendor and signing the contract.

Restricted Nvidia chips continue to circulate in China’s university market. Procurement records also show that US export‑controlled Nvidia AI chips and computing services have formed a broader supply channel in the Chinese higher‑education sector.

Shenzhen University bought three H100 chips in September for 769,800 yuan; the high‑end AI chip is also banned from export to China. Wuhan University of Technology purchased a server with an H100 chip in June for 355,000 yuan and also bought four A100 chips for 344,000 yuan.

Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, another of China’s “Seven Defense Sons,” bought four A800 processors in April for 489,000 yuan. The university has close ties to China’s aerospace and defence industry, with research covering military aviation and space programmes.

In July and September, the Chinese Academy of Sciences announced two government procurement notices listing suppliers selected to provide computing services that use Nvidia H800 and A800 chips, which are subject to US export restrictions. One notice priced H800 computing services at 10 yuan per chip per hour.
A January procurement notice listed a supplier that will provide six A100 chips to a public institution in Shenzhen, under a contract worth 484,800 yuan.

Reuters previously reported that Chinese organisations obtain restricted Nvidia chips installed in servers from Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US), Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) through domestic distributors.
The outlet also uncovered an underground market in China for restricted Nvidia chips, with supply coming from overseas stockpiles and third‑country intermediaries.

items.title: 輝達比大盤還便宜！估值探15年低點 是買點還是接刀？
items.title_en: Nvidia Cheaper Than the Market! Valuation Hits 15-Year Low – Buying Opportunity or a Trap?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價重挫後，未來12個月預估本益比降至不到12倍，創15年來最低，甚至低於標普500指數。部分華爾街人士認為，強勁成長前景讓輝達的投資吸引力浮現，但低估值也反映另一層疑慮：市場是否仍相信獲利預測，以及執行長黃仁勳能否繼續掌舵。
綜合外媒報導，輝達周三(11日)盤前一度上漲3%，報173.99美元，但過去一個月已下跌24%。黃仁勳承認與一名被指涉及對中間諜活動的女子有婚外情後，股價本周跌勢加深，領導階層的不確定性也成為投資人重新評估公司的關鍵。

本益比跌破12倍 低於大盤的便宜有何代價

根據FactSet數據，輝達未來12個月預估本益比降至11.77倍，為2011年以來最低，標普500指數同期則約18倍。換言之，投資人為輝達每1美元預期獲利支付的價格，已不到12美元。
然而，這項估值建立在預期獲利能夠實現的前提上。外媒指出，問題在於輝達究竟遭到低估，還是投資人開始質疑那些讓股價顯得便宜的獲利預測。
輝達股價在黃仁勳風波爆發前就已走弱，如今他的去留又增添變數。因此，預估本益比降至低點，並不等於市場已認定股價觸底。

瑞穗砍目標價仍看高成長 基金經理人認為行情未完

瑞穗分析師Vijay Rakesh將輝達目標價從315美元下修至250美元，但仍認為黃仁勳留任的可能性較高。他指出，黃仁勳離職是輝達面臨的主要風險，不過，考量其關鍵創辦人與領導者地位，以及董事會的強力支持，這項風險可望受到抑制。
Rakesh的250美元目標價，是以2028會計年度預估獲利的16倍本益比計算；該會計年度大致對應2027曆年。他預期，輝達該年度營收與獲利均將成長逾70%，因此認為這樣的估值要求並不高。
這項目標價採用的獲利期間，與目前11.77倍本益比所依據的未來12個月不同，兩者不能直接視為同一期間的估值比較。
持有輝達股票的Gunderson Capital Management總裁Bill Gunderson則表示，從估值角度來看，他認為目前市場上沒有比輝達更便宜的成長股。他以棒球比賽比喻，這波行情可能才進行到九局中的第三、第四局，後面仍有發展空間。

獲利能否兌現 黃仁勳去留與融資環境成考驗

看多論點能否成立，仍取決於公司成長與領導穩定性。輝達周二宣布，由Wachtell Lipton律師事務所主導獨立調查，前聯邦檢察官Joon Kim負責，釐清公司是否成為外國間諜活動的目標。
董事會周日表示，目前沒有理由相信公司機密或國家安全因黃仁勳的婚外情而受到危害。不過，輝達沒有明顯的接班人選，黃仁勳過去也曾公開否定接班規劃的必要性，且直接向他報告的主管範圍異常廣泛。該刊先前主張，除非黃仁勳被迫離職，否則輝達仍值得持有。
總體環境則是另一項風險。高於預期的通膨數據推升更大幅度升息的可能性，2年期美債殖利率周二出現2025年4月以來最大單日升幅，可能進一步提高AI產業融資成本。
聯準會(Fed)金融監管副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)也警告，今年AI相關債務規模預計將超過8,000億美元，企業透過貸款、投資與財務擔保形成愈來愈緊密的連結。若龐大投資未能帶來預期回報，衝擊可能擴散至科技業以外的企業與消費者。
輝達將於11月17日公布財報。對投資人而言，判斷低估值是否構成機會，關鍵仍是後續業績能否支撐獲利預期，以及公司能否降低領導階層的不確定性。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares plunged, its forward 12‑month price‑to‑earnings ratio is projected to fall below 12×, the lowest in 15 years and even lower than the S&P 500. Some Wall Street voices say strong growth prospects revive Nvidia’s appeal, but the low valuation also raises a question: does the market still believe the earnings forecasts and can CEO Jensen Huang continue to steer the ship?

According to foreign media, Nvidia briefly rose 3% to $173.99 in pre‑market trading on Wednesday (the 11th) before falling 24% over the past month. Huang’s admission of an affair with a woman alleged to be involved in espionage against China deepened the stock’s weekly decline, and leadership uncertainty has become a key factor for investors reassessing the company.

Forward P/E drops below 12× – what’s the price of cheapness compared with the broader market? FactSet data shows Nvidia’s forward 12‑month P/E is expected to fall to 11.77×, the lowest since 2011, while the S&P 500’s forward P/E is about 18×. In other words, investors are paying less than $12 for each $1 of expected earnings from Nvidia.

However, this valuation rests on the assumption that the earnings forecasts will materialise. Foreign reports point out the issue: is Nvidia truly undervalued, or are investors beginning to doubt the profit projections that make the stock appear cheap?

Nvidia’s share price was already weakening before the Huang scandal broke, and his possible departure now adds another variable. Therefore, a projected low forward P/E does not mean the market has confirmed a bottom.

Mizuho cut its target price but still sees high growth. Analyst Vijay Rakesh lowered Nvidia’s target from $315 to $250, yet he believes Huang is likely to stay. He notes that Huang’s exit would be Nvidia’s biggest risk, but given Huang’s role as founder and leader and strong board support, that risk should be contained.

Rakesh’s $250 target is based on a 16× P/E applied to earnings projected for fiscal 2028, which roughly aligns with calendar year 2027. He expects revenue and earnings that year to grow more than 70%, so he views that valuation as modest.
The earnings period used for that target differs from the 12‑month forward P/E of 11.77×, so the two valuations cannot be directly compared as covering the same timeframe.

Bill Gunderson, president of Gunderson Capital Management, said that from a valuation standpoint he sees no cheaper growth stock than Nvidia in the market today. He likened the rally to a baseball game that is only in the third or fourth inning of the ninth, suggesting there is still room to develop.

Whether bullish arguments hold depends on the company’s growth and leadership stability. Nvidia announced on Tuesday that an independent investigation, led by law firm Wachtell Lipton and former federal prosecutor Joon Kim, will examine whether the company has become a target of foreign espionage.

The board said on Sunday there is no reason to believe company secrets or national security have been compromised by Huang’s affair. However, Nvidia lacks a clear successor; Huang has previously dismissed the need for a succession plan, and his reporting span is unusually broad. The publication previously argued that unless Huang is forced out, Nvidia remains a hold.

The broader environment is another risk. Higher‑than‑expected inflation data raise the odds of larger rate hikes, and two‑year U.S. Treasury yields jumped the biggest single‑day increase since April 2025 on Tuesday, potentially raising financing costs for the AI sector.

Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman warned that AI‑related debt could exceed $800 billion this year, tightening the link between corporate borrowing, investment and financial guarantees. If massive investments fail to deliver expected returns, the fallout could spread beyond tech firms to other companies and consumers.

Nvidia will release its earnings on November 17. For investors, deciding whether the low valuation is an opportunity hinges on whether upcoming results can support earnings expectations and whether the company can reduce leadership uncertainty.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 2027 年資本支出 400 億到 450 億元！增幅收斂，經費轉向電力設施
items.title_en: Quanta Computer (2382) 2027 Capital Expenditure Forecast at NT$40‑45 Billion! Growth Rate Narrows, Spending Shifts to Power Infrastructure
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 預估 2027 年資本支出 400 億到 450 億元，比 2026 年全年目標的 400 億元高出 0% 到 12.5%，成長幅度已經收斂，經費的流向也跟著調整，主要流向電力設施與水冷系統，廠房本身的支出比重下降。
公司 2026 年前 9 個月已投入 346 億元，其中第 3 季 128 億元，美國加州與泰國兩地合計占前 9 個月資本支出的近 8 成。現金流量表上購置不動產、廠房及設備的金額是另一組數字，前 3 季合計 322.4 億元、第 3 季 106.5 億元，都比公司口述的 346 億元與 128 億元少。
資本支出的規模由客戶承諾決定。公司表示，AI 機櫃系統組裝測試的擴廠前提，是先取得雲端服務供應商客戶未來 12 到 24 個月的產能預留承諾，資本支出因此建立在確定性極高的資產利用率上。
電力到位要等 18 到 36 個月限制產能的是電。公司指出，目前全球主要的 AI 伺服器生產地，無論美國、墨西哥、台灣或東南亞，要取得百萬瓦等級以上的工業電力，都是長達 18 到 36 個月的審批與建置流程。新世代 AI 機櫃朝更高算力密度、更高耗電量演進，單一機櫃用電大增，現有工廠的有效產能跟著縮水，擴產因此沒有停下來的空間。
2026 年底前 AI 產能較 2025 年底倍增的目標並未鬆動，公司預估可望如期達成，理由是客戶對 AI 產品的路線規劃已經延伸到 2 年之後。
2027 年的擴充重點從產線轉向電力。公司說明，電路板打件產線在 2026 年已大致備妥，2027 年主要建置的是電力，產能規劃因此改以測試量衡量。同樣一台測試機櫃，測新世代 VR200 機櫃的時間比測上一代 GB200 更長，同一批機櫃能測的量因此變少，需要的電力也更多。
承租廠房是擴產的常態，廣達在海外布局 AI 伺服器產能時很少從零買地蓋廠，絕大多數是承租既有工業廠房，在 IFRS 16 會計準則下帳列使用權資產，大額支出落在屋況改良與電力升級。前 9 個月營收 2.96 兆元，資本支出 346 億元，公司表示資本支出強度維持在營收的 1% 上下。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，2016 年以來單季資本支出金額走高，2025 年之後明顯跳升，佔營收比重到 2026 年第 3 季都還貼在 1% 附近，代表擴產的錢相對營收規模一直很小。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
資本支出集中在通用設施，與接單模式有關。公司表示，AI 機櫃屬於客製化的專案接單生產，投入的電力設施與水冷系統屬於通用型基礎設施，即使單一客戶或特定世代的 AI 伺服器需求放緩，也能切換去支援下一代 GPU、雲端業者自研的晶片或次世代機櫃。
客戶延後提貨要付倉租客戶的預留承諾沒有書面協議綁定，公司認為約束力仍然足夠，因為在買賣模式下，客人原本下訂的機櫃會由客人買走。公司表示，「客人基本上是會承諾買走他原來的東西」，若提貨遞延，客人會負擔相關的利息、倉租與衍生費用。
成本結構以變動成本為主，折舊費用占營業成本約 0.5%。公司指出，核心業務的息前稅前折舊攤銷前利益在扣除利息與所得稅支出後，足以覆蓋資本支出與現金股利。
廣達的擴產速度因此由電力到位的時間決定，2027 年電力設施占資本支出的比重會再上升。審批動輒 18 到 36 個月，2027 年能開出多少產能，看的是 2026 年送出的電力申請。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) estimates its 2027 capital expenditure at NT$40 billion to NT$45 billion, 0%‑12.5% higher than the NT$40 billion full‑year target for 2026. The growth rate has narrowed and the spending focus has shifted, with most funds now directed toward power facilities and water‑cooling systems, while the share allocated to the factories themselves has declined.

The company had already invested NT$34.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026, including NT$12.8 billion in the third quarter. Capital spending in California, USA and Thailand together accounted for nearly 80% of the nine‑month total. The cash‑flow statement’s figure for purchases of property, plant and equipment is a different number – NT$32.24 billion for the first three quarters and NT$10.65 billion for Q3 – both lower than the verbally reported NT$34.6 billion and NT$12.8 billion.

The scale of capital spending is driven by customer commitments. Quanta says that expanding AI rack‑system assembly and testing hinges on securing capacity‑reservation commitments from cloud‑service customers for the next 12‑24 months, so the capital outlay is based on a very high certainty of asset utilization.

Power availability can take 18‑36 months, which limits capacity. The company notes that in all major AI server production regions – the United States, Mexico, Taiwan and Southeast Asia – obtaining industrial power of a megawatt‑scale or higher requires an approval and construction process that lasts 18‑36 months. New‑generation AI racks are moving toward higher compute density and higher power consumption, dramatically increasing per‑rack electricity use; existing factories’ effective capacity shrinks, leaving no room to pause expansion.

The goal of doubling AI capacity by the end of 2026 compared with the end of 2025 remains unchanged, and Quanta expects to meet it on schedule because customers’ AI product roadmaps now extend at least two years ahead.

In 2027 the expansion focus shifts from production lines to power. Quanta explains that the PCB assembly lines were largely ready in 2026, so the 2027 priority is building power infrastructure, with capacity planning now measured by test volume. Testing a new‑generation VR200 rack takes longer than testing the previous‑generation GB200, so fewer racks can be tested per batch and more power is required.

Leasing factories is the norm for expansion. When Quanta builds AI server capacity overseas, it rarely buys land and builds new plants; instead it mostly leases existing industrial facilities, recording right‑of‑use assets under IFRS 16. Large outlays go to building improvements and power upgrades. Revenue for the first nine months was NT$2.96 trillion, with capital spending of NT$34.6 billion, keeping the spending intensity at roughly 1% of revenue.

According to a chart from You Analysis’ industry database, quarterly capital spending has risen since 2016, jumped noticeably after 2025, and the share of spending relative to revenue stayed near 1% through Q3 2026, indicating that expansion funds remain small compared with revenue scale.
Source: You Analysis industry database

Capital spending is concentrated in generic facilities and is linked to the order model. Quanta says AI racks are custom‑project orders, while the power and water‑cooling infrastructure are generic base facilities. Even if a single customer or a specific AI server generation slows, the facilities can be repurposed to support the next‑generation GPUs, cloud providers’ in‑house chips, or future rack designs.

If customers delay pickup they must pay storage fees; the reservation commitment is not tied to a written contract, but Quanta believes the binding force is sufficient because under the sales model the customer originally orders the rack and is expected to purchase it. The company states, “Customers basically commit to buying what they ordered,” and if pickup is deferred they will bear the related interest, storage rent and ancillary costs.

The cost structure is dominated by variable costs, with depreciation accounting for about 0.5% of operating costs. Quanta points out that core operating profit before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation, after deducting interest and income‑tax expenses, is enough to cover capital spending and cash dividends.

Thus Quanta’s expansion speed is dictated by the timing of power availability, and the proportion of capital spending devoted to power facilities will rise again in 2027. With approvals typically taking 18‑36 months, the amount of capacity that can be launched in 2027 depends on the power applications submitted in 2026.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 197 億元買廠案終止！AI 產能改由海外租廠接手
items.title_en: Quanta (2382) Terminates NT$19.7 Billion Plant Purchase; AI Capacity Shifted to Overseas Leased Facilities
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 2026 年 10 月 29 日公告撤銷向面板廠友達光電購買桃園華亞廠房的交易。這筆金額約 197 億元的資產取得案在 2026 年 7 月 28 日才經董事會通過，雙方最後對廠房使用規格與交付時程沒有達成共識。
交易標的是桃園市龜山區華亞段土地約 1.97 萬坪、建物約 4.93 萬坪與附屬設備一批，總金額約 197 億元。兩家不動產估價師事務所的估價金額分別是 193.31 億元與 192.58 億元，公司依這兩份估價報告議價後定案。
撤銷之後，公司表示將轉向海外，以承租廠房的方式擴大當地的產能規模。
買地蓋廠不是主要路徑承租廠房本來就是廣達擴產的常態。公司表示，海外布局 AI 伺服器產能時很少從零買地蓋廠，絕大多數是承租既有工業廠房，在 IFRS 16 會計準則下帳列使用權資產，為的是兼顧加速量產時程與資產輕量化，大額支出落在承租後的屋況改良與電力升級。
這座廠房原本對應的產能時程排在 2028 年。公司在會上強調，撤銷後 2028 年的產能規劃沒有調整，原因是原本要放在華亞廠的產能，改由海外據點補上。客戶對 AI 產品的路線規劃已經延伸到 2 年之後，擴產需求並沒有因為這筆交易終止而消失。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估 2028 年營收約 6.8 兆元，比 2027 年的 5.54 兆元增加 23%，預估區間的上緣最高到 8.47 兆元。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
資本支出的重心已經在海外。廣達 2026 年前 9 個月投入 346 億元，其中第 3 季 128 億元，美國加州與泰國兩地合計占前 9 個月資本支出的近 8 成；兩地都是以承租廠房為基礎，再往外擴建電力與冷卻設施。
公司預估 2027 年資本支出 400 億到 450 億元，比 2026 年的目標 400 億元略高，成長幅度收斂，主要建置項目是電力。公司說明，電路板打件產線在 2026 年已大致備妥，2027 年要看的是測試量能開到多大，因為同樣一台測試機櫃，測新世代 VR200 機櫃的時間比測上一代 GB200 更長，同樣的機櫃數量因此不足。
電力決定產能上限產能上限受制於電力供應。公司指出，全球主要的 AI 伺服器生產地，無論美國、墨西哥、台灣或東南亞，要取得百萬瓦等級以上的工業電力，都是長達 18 到 36 個月的審批與建置流程。新世代機櫃的用電量大增，現有工廠的有效產能會跟著縮水，擴產的幅度因此受制於電力到位的速度。
197 億元的買廠案終止後，廣達取得產能的方式改為承租廠房與電力升級，2028 年的產能規劃維持原案，取得產能的地點則由台灣轉向海外據點。這條路的節奏由電力審批的時間決定，廠房買賣的進度不再是決定因素。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta (2382‑TW) announced on October 29, 2026 that it had withdrawn its agreement to purchase the Huaya plant in Taoyuan from panel maker AU Optronics. The roughly NT$19.7 billion asset acquisition, approved by the board on July 28, 2026, fell through because the parties could not agree on the plant’s usage specifications and delivery schedule.

The transaction involved land in the Huaya section of Guishan District, Taoyuan City of about 19,700 ping, buildings of about 49,300 ping and associated equipment, with a total price of approximately NT$19.7 billion. Two real‑estate appraisal firms valued the assets at NT$19.331 billion and NT$19.258 billion respectively, and the company negotiated based on these reports.
After the cancellation, the company said it will shift overseas and expand capacity by leasing factories rather than buying them.

Purchasing land and building a plant is not the primary route; leasing facilities has always been Quanta’s normal expansion method. The company noted that when it expands AI server capacity abroad it rarely buys land and builds from scratch; instead it mostly leases existing industrial buildings and records the right‑of‑use asset under IFRS 16, balancing faster mass‑production timelines with a lightweight asset profile, with major spending focused on building upgrades and power upgrades after leasing.

The plant’s original capacity schedule was set for 2028. The company emphasized at the meeting that the 2028 capacity plan remains unchanged after the cancellation, because the capacity originally slated for the Huaya plant will be made up at overseas sites. Customers’ AI product roadmaps already extend two years beyond, so the expansion demand has not vanished despite the deal’s termination.

According to the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, institutional investors on average forecast 2028 revenue of about NT$6.8 trillion, a 23% increase over the NT$5.54 trillion projected for 2027, with the upper end of the estimate reaching NT$8.47 trillion.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

Capital expenditures are now focused overseas. Quanta invested NT$34.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026, including NT$12.8 billion in Q3, with California, USA and Thailand together accounting for nearly 80% of the nine‑month capex; both locations base their expansions on leased facilities and further build out power and cooling infrastructure.

The company projects 2027 capital expenditures of NT$40 billion to NT$45 billion, slightly above the 2026 target of NT$40 billion, with growth tapering and the main focus on power. It explained that the circuit‑board assembly line was largely ready in 2026, and 2027 will hinge on how much testing capacity can be opened, because testing a new‑generation VR200 rack takes longer than testing the previous‑generation GB200, making the same number of racks insufficient.

Power determines the upper limit of capacity. The company pointed out that in the world’s main AI server production regions—whether the United States, Mexico, Taiwan or Southeast Asia—obtaining industrial power of a megawatt class or higher requires an approval and construction process of 18 to 36 months. The new‑generation racks consume much more electricity, shrinking the effective capacity of existing factories, so expansion is constrained by the speed of power availability.

After the NT$19.7 billion plant purchase was cancelled, Quanta will acquire capacity by leasing factories and upgrading power, keeping the 2028 capacity plan unchanged while shifting the location from Taiwan to overseas sites. The pace of this path is dictated by power‑approval timelines, no longer by the progress of plant transactions.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 更多 AI 專案改由客戶供料！拿到的是毛利率，讓掉的是營收認列
items.title_en: Quanta (2382) Shifts More AI Projects to Customer-Supplied Consignment; Gains Gross Margin but Loses Revenue Recognition
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 打算把更多 AI 伺服器專案從買賣改為寄售（consignment），由客戶自己提供 GPU、記憶體等關鍵零組件，廣達只收組裝與測試費用，不認列這部分的營收。原本的做法是廣達先買進零件、組裝成整櫃，再賣給客戶。
毛利率因此上升。零組件的營收與成本同時從財報移出，這部分屬於低毛利的買賣，比重下降之後，整體毛利率的比率就會提高，但營收金額會變小。
目前談成的案子集中在單價最高的零件，公司表示，已經有部分專案談成寄售，都鎖定單價較高的 GPU，談法以 GPU 為主，或再加上記憶體；整櫃都轉寄售的情況還沒有出現。
轉向這個模式的原因是機櫃單價上漲，公司指出，NVIDIA 平台從 B200 換到 GB200，平均單價接近原來的 2 倍，要維持相同的毛利率有難度；下一代 NVL200、NVL300 的單價更高，組裝廠很難承擔那麼高的存貨金額，即使這些零件最後會隨著機櫃出貨而變現。
寄售讓營收認列變少代價與好處都寫在公司的指引裡，公司表示，拿到更多寄售專案，全公司營收就不會成長，會比現在低一些，市場期待毛利率變好又期待營收不下降，「這兩個事情事實上不太可能同時發生」。
寄售的推進還受客戶條件限制，公司說明，寄售不是每個客戶都能馬上接受，需要時間理解流程，也不是每一個專案都適用，目前是逐個客戶談，希望 2027 年有更多客戶同意。
AI 伺服器營收高雙位數成長的估計，只算已經談成的寄售專案。公司說明，還沒談成的部分沒有算進去，寄售談成的速度取決於客戶的資金與交期。
第 4 季的指引也反映同一件事，即使只有少量 AI 出貨轉為寄售，公司預期利潤率仍持續承壓，其中毛利率比第 3 季略微下滑，營業利益率以與第 3 季持平為目標；壓力一個來自 AI 機櫃單價持續上揚稀釋毛利率，另一個來自筆電出貨減少、經濟規模變差。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，2026 年第 3 季實際毛利率 4.75%，低於法人共識的 5.1%；法人對 2027 年各季毛利率的預估落在 4.72% 到 4.83%。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
公司希望市場把注意力放在金額上，不要只盯著比率。前 9 個月營業利益 894.7 億元、年增 41.2%，營業費用成長 21.9%，營業利益成長率大於費用成長率，公司指出投入資本報酬率仍維持在 20% 以上。
寄售把高價零件的存貨與資金壓力留在客戶端，廣達換到較好的毛利率與較輕的資產，代價是營收認列變少。2027 年要擴大多少，取決於還在談的專案最後條件，談成的比例愈高，營收認列與毛利率一增一減的幅度就愈大。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta (2382‑TW) plans to convert more AI server projects from outright purchase to consignment, letting customers provide key components such as GPUs and memory while Quanta only charges assembly and testing fees and does not recognize revenue for those parts. Previously Quanta bought the components, assembled full cabinets, and then sold them to customers.

As a result, gross margin improves. Both component revenue and cost are removed from the financial statements; since this low‑margin trading portion shrinks, the overall gross‑margin ratio rises even though total revenue declines.

The deals currently signed focus on the highest‑priced components. The company says some projects have already been agreed on a consignment basis, targeting higher‑priced GPUs, either on a GPU‑only basis or combined with memory; full‑cabinet consignment has not yet occurred.

The shift is driven by rising cabinet prices. Quanta notes that NVIDIA platforms have moved from B200 to GB200, with average unit prices nearly double the previous level, making it hard to maintain the same gross margin; next‑generation NVL200 and NVL300 are even pricier, and assemblers find it difficult to bear such high inventory costs even though the parts will eventually be realized when cabinets ship.

Consignment reduces revenue recognition; the trade‑off and benefits are outlined in the company’s guidance. Quanta says that taking on more consignment projects will keep overall revenue flat or slightly lower, while the market hopes for better margins without revenue decline – “these two outcomes are realistically unlikely to happen together.”

Consignment rollout is also limited by customer conditions. The company explains that not every customer can immediately accept consignment; they need time to understand the process and not every project is suitable. Negotiations are done client‑by‑client, with hopes that more customers will agree in 2027.

The estimate of double‑digit AI server revenue growth only counts projects already agreed on consignment. The company notes that unfinalized projects are excluded, and the speed of consignment signing depends on customers’ funding and delivery schedules.

The Q4 guidance reflects the same issue: even with a small amount of AI shipments shifted to consignment, Quanta expects profit margins to stay under pressure, with gross margin slightly down from Q3 and operating margin targeted to match Q3. Pressure comes from rising AI cabinet prices diluting margins and from reduced laptop shipments and weaker economies of scale.

According to the chart from U‑Analysis industry database, Q3 2026 actual gross margin was 4.75%, below the consensus estimate of 5.1%; analysts forecast 2027 quarterly gross margins between 4.72% and 4.83%.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

The company wants the market to focus on absolute figures rather than just ratios. For the first nine months, operating profit was NT$89.47 billion, up 41.2% year‑over‑year, with operating expenses up 21.9%; profit growth outpaced expense growth, and return on invested capital remains above 20%.

Consignment leaves the inventory and capital burden of high‑priced parts with customers, giving Quanta better gross margins and a lighter asset base at the cost of lower revenue recognition. How much expansion occurs in 2027 will depend on the final terms of projects still under negotiation; the higher the win rate, the larger the opposite swing between revenue recognition and gross margin.

items.title: 廣達(2382) AI 機櫃出貨變少、營收仍成長！成長動能換成單價
items.title_en: Quanta (2382) AI Cabinet Shipments Decline, Yet Revenue Still Grows! Growth Shifts to Pricing
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 第 3 季 AI 伺服器出貨櫃數小幅下滑，這條產品線的營收仍比第 2 季成長，成長動能由出貨量換成平均單價。公司預期第 4 季方向相同：出貨總櫃數比第 3 季略減，營收繼續季增。
變動來自新舊世代的轉換。公司表示，第 3 季伺服器產品組合改變，AI 伺服器出貨量略減，營收成長改由平均單價驅動；通用型伺服器的出貨量只有小幅季增，平均單價則比第 2 季繼續走高。
出貨櫃數減少多少，取決於各客戶的拉貨時序。公司指出，第 3 季每個客戶對 NVL200、NVL300、HGX200 這幾代 NVIDIA 平台的拉貨時間不同，有人提前、有人往後，時序差異造成出貨櫃數的起伏。
出貨櫃數不再是好指標櫃數會失真，原因是每個機櫃搭載的晶片不同。公司指出，出貨的組裝層級從 L10 的整機組裝到 L11 的整櫃整合測試都有，每個機櫃裡的 GPU 與 CPU 數量不見得相同，客戶採用的晶片組合也不一樣。
非 NVIDIA 的比重愈高，用出貨量推估營收就愈不準，因為這些機櫃裡的 GPU、ASIC 與 Arm 架構 CPU 組合差異更大，同樣的櫃數對應的營收差距也更大。
公司因此只給方向與金額，不提供 2027 年 AI 機櫃出貨櫃數的預估，第 4 季的展望寫的是營收季增與櫃數略減。
一般型伺服器是另一個支撐。第 3 季出貨量小幅季增、單價走高，公司預期第 4 季出貨量維持季增；2027 年一般型伺服器營收仍是雙位數成長，成長來源是能自行執行任務的 AI 代理應用帶動的一般運算需求。
全年來看，伺服器占全公司營收的比重在本年開始已突破 80%，AI 伺服器占整體伺服器業務 75% 到 80%，換算下來對廣達總營收的貢獻約六成。
第 4 季的第一個月已經看到營收續增。廣達 10 月營收 3,532 億元，比 9 月的 3,253 億元增加 8.6%，年增 103.96%，前 10 月累計 3.31 兆元。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，2026 年 7 月以來月營收都在 3,200 億元以上，10 月的 3,532 億元年增 103.96%，等於營收是去年同期的兩倍。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
2027 年第 1 季的出貨會比第 4 季明顯放大。公司說明，新舊世代的轉換是逐步推進的過程，全年 AI 伺服器營收維持高雙位數成長；2026 年 AI 伺服器營收遠優於倍增目標，基期已高，要維持三位數成長難度較大。
廣達這條產品線的營收與出貨櫃數會持續背離，櫃數下滑的季度不代表需求轉弱。2027 年第 1 季出貨放大之前，左右營收的是單價與產品組合。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta (2382‑TW) saw a slight decline in the number of AI server cabinets shipped in Q3, but revenue for this product line still grew compared with Q2, with growth driven by higher average unit prices rather than volume. The company expects a similar pattern in Q4: total shipped cabinets will be slightly lower than Q3, while revenue continues to rise quarter over quarter.

The shift stems from the transition between old and new generations. Quanta said the server portfolio changed in Q3, with AI server shipments edging down and revenue growth now driven by higher average prices; general‑purpose server shipments saw only modest quarterly growth, but their average price kept rising from Q2.

The extent of the cabinet count decline depends on each customer’s pull‑forward timing. Quanta noted that in Q3, customers pulled NVIDIA platforms NVL200, NVL300 and HGX200 at different times—some early, some later—creating fluctuations in shipped cabinet numbers.

Cabinet count is no longer a reliable indicator because it can be misleading, given the varying chips per cabinet. Quanta explained that shipped units range from L10 full‑machine assembly to L11 full‑cabinet integration testing, and the number of GPUs and CPUs per cabinet, as well as the chip mix used by customers, can differ.

The higher proportion of non‑NVIDIA units makes revenue estimation from shipment volume increasingly inaccurate, as the mix of GPUs, ASICs and Arm‑based CPUs varies more, leading to larger revenue gaps for the same cabinet count.

Consequently, the company only provides direction and amount, without forecasting the number of AI cabinets to be shipped in 2027; the Q4 outlook mentions revenue growth and a slight dip in cabinet count.

General‑purpose servers provide another support pillar. In Q3, shipments rose modestly and prices increased; Quanta expects shipments to keep growing in Q4. For 2027, general‑purpose server revenue is projected to maintain double‑digit growth, driven by AI‑agent applications that generate ordinary computing demand.

For the full year, servers accounted for over 80% of Quanta’s total revenue, with AI servers making up 75%‑80% of the overall server business, translating to roughly 60% of Quanta’s total revenue contribution.

In the first month of Q4, revenue continued to rise. Quanta’s October revenue was NT$353.2 billion, up 8.6% from September’s NT$325.3 billion and up 103.96% year‑over‑year, bringing the cumulative revenue for the first ten months to NT$3.31 trillion.

As shown in the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, monthly revenue has stayed above NT$320 billion since July 2026; October’s NT$353.2 billion represents a 103.96% year‑over‑year increase, essentially double the revenue of the same month last year.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

Shipments in Q1 2027 will be markedly larger than in Q4. The company explained that the transition between generations is a gradual process, with AI server revenue expected to sustain high double‑digit growth throughout the year; AI server revenue in 2026 far exceeded its doubling target, setting a high base that makes maintaining triple‑digit growth more challenging.

Revenue and shipment cabinet counts for this product line will continue to diverge; a quarter with declining cabinet numbers does not signal weakening demand. Before the Q1 2027 shipment surge, revenue is driven by pricing and product mix.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 2027 年伺服器占營收 85% 以上！筆電貢獻首度降至個位數
items.title_en: Quanta Computer (2382) Projects Server Revenue to Exceed 85% in 2027, Laptop Contribution Falls to Single Digits
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 的營收結構一年之內再度往伺服器集中。公司預估 2027 年伺服器占總營收 85% 到 90%，AI 伺服器占伺服器營收 80% 以上，筆電對營收的貢獻則首度降到個位數百分比；2026 年伺服器占全公司營收的比重才剛突破 80%。
筆電的縮減在 2026 年已經完成大部分。第 3 季出貨 960 萬台，季減 16.5%、年減 24%，原本公司預期會衰退兩成以上，實際跌幅較小；公司預估第 4 季仍將雙位數百分比遞減，全年出貨下滑幅度落在 15% 到 20% 之間。
進入第 4 季，出貨量再往下走。優分析產業資料庫的出貨統計顯示，2026 年 10 月筆電出貨 270 萬台，比 9 月的 420 萬台減少 35.7%；第 3 季 960 萬台換算每月平均 320 萬台，10 月比這個月均低約 16%。
記憶體價格牽動筆電2027 年筆電出貨仍會年減，公司估計與產業跌幅相當，筆電市場大約下滑高個位數到一成。公司表示，2027 年記憶體價格目前聽到的水準與現在差不多，價格若不回落，受影響的不只筆電與個人電腦，所有相關的消費性產品都會承受較高的記憶體成本，影響程度按產品單價不同而有差別。
伺服器兩條線都往上支撐營收的是 AI 伺服器與一般型伺服器。公司指出，2027 年兩者都維持雙位數年增，伺服器業務占總營收的比重繼續攀升，其中 AI 伺服器可望占 80% 以上，來源是客戶的產品路線已經規劃到 2 年之後。
AI 伺服器目前占整體伺服器業務 75% 到 80%，對全公司營收的貢獻約 60% 到 65%；2027 年伺服器占 85% 到 90%，比重比 2026 年的 80% 以上再拉高一階。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，法人對 2027 年單季營收的預估，第 1 季是 1.15 兆元、第 2 季 1.27 兆元、第 3 季 1.38 兆元，都高於 2026 年第 3 季的 1.12 兆元。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
筆電的旺季效應在 2026 年已經消失。過去第 3 季是筆電全年的出貨高峰，2026 年下半年市場需求明顯疲弱，第 4 季還會再減。筆電仍在出貨，占營收的比重卻一路往下，說明筆電在營收裡的角色已經改變。
2027 年的廣達，是一家伺服器占 85% 以上營收的公司；筆電則是規模縮小、跟產業同步起伏的業務。

paras_en: November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) is shifting its revenue mix even more toward servers within a year. The company forecasts that servers will account for 85% to 90% of total revenue in 2027, with AI servers making up over 80% of server revenue, while laptop contribution to revenue drops to single‑digit percentages for the first time; in 2026, server revenue just broke the 80% threshold of total company revenue.

The laptop decline was largely completed in 2026. Third‑quarter shipments were 9.6 million units, down 16.5% quarter‑over‑quarter and 24% year‑over‑year, a smaller drop than the more than 20% decline the company had expected; the firm projects another double‑digit percentage decline in Q4, with full‑year shipment falling between 15% and 20%.

In Q4 shipments fell further. Data from U‑Analysis’ industry database show laptop shipments in October 2026 were 2.7 million units, a 35.7% drop from September’s 4.2 million. The 9.6 million units shipped in Q3 average to about 3.2 million per month, so October was roughly 16% lower than that monthly average.

Memory‑price pressure will keep laptop shipments declining in 2027, with the company expecting a drop comparable to the industry’s, roughly high single‑digit to ten‑percent decline. Quanta says current memory price levels are similar to today’s; if prices do not fall, not only laptops and PCs but all related consumer products will bear higher memory costs, with impact varying by product price point.

Both AI servers and standard servers are driving revenue growth. The company notes that both lines will maintain double‑digit annual growth in 2027, further raising the share of server business in total revenue, with AI servers expected to account for over 80% as customers have product roadmaps extending two years ahead.

AI servers already represent 75% to 80% of total server business and contribute about 60% to 65% of overall revenue; in 2027 servers are projected to make up 85% to 90% of revenue, lifting the share above the 80%+ level seen in 2026.

According to U‑Analysis’ industry database, institutional forecasts for quarterly revenue in 2027 are 1.15 trillion TWD for Q1, 1.27 trillion TWD for Q2 and 1.38 trillion TWD for Q3, all higher than the 1.12 trillion TWD recorded in Q3 2026.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

The laptop peak season has vanished in 2026. Historically Q3 was the annual peak for laptop shipments, but demand weakened markedly in the second half of 2026 and will decline further in Q4. Laptops still ship, but their share of revenue keeps falling, indicating a changed role in the company’s earnings mix.
In 2027 Quanta will be a company where servers account for more than 85% of revenue; laptops will be a smaller, industry‑aligned business line.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 非 NVIDIA 平台占比 2027 年升到兩位數！ASIC 毛利率不比通用伺服器差
items.title_en: Quanta (2382) Non‑NVIDIA Platform Share to Reach Double‑Digits by 2027; ASIC Gross Margin Not Worse Than General‑Purpose Servers
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 承接的非 NVIDIA 平台 2026 年占營收還不到 10%，公司預估 2027 年這個比重會升到兩位數百分比；成長動能來自雲端業者自研的 ASIC 伺服器與超微（AMD）的平台，NVIDIA 則繼續是 GPU 路線的主要供應商。
平台世代正在交替，公司表示，出貨會逐步從 GB200、GB300 這兩個現行機櫃世代移到 VR200，再往下一代的 VR Ultra 走；VR200 之後的機櫃規格有 72 顆、144 顆、288 顆 GPU 等不同組合，GB300 與 GB200 還有需求，「主流還是回到 VR200 的方向為主」。
超微（AMD）的 GPU 平台也是選項之一，公司指出，AMD 的 GPU 平台 2026 年就有出貨，2027 年會繼續出貨；在 GPU 這條路線裡，客戶仍以 NVIDIA 為主要選擇。
非 NVIDIA 比重往上公司指出，AI 代理應用帶動一般運算需求，雲端業者把更多一般型伺服器專案交給組裝廠，2026 年一般型伺服器的成長因此優於預期。x86 與 Arm 兩種架構的出貨都在增加，其中 x86 稍微多一些；2027 年一般型伺服器仍是雙位數成長。
平台組合變動之外，營收規模也在放大，公司預估 2027 年 AI 伺服器營收維持高雙位數成長。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估 2028 年營收約 6.8 兆元、每股盈餘 36.22 元，比 2027 年的 5.59 兆元與 28.07 元各高出兩成二與兩成九。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
毛利率的比較要看整櫃系統，公司說明，每個客戶的專案內容不同，同樣是 ASIC，不同客戶的毛利結構也不一樣；一般而言，ASIC 的毛利率不會比一般型伺服器差。
主要客戶仍是五家大型雲端服務供應商，新型雲端業者（neocloud）的案子多由 GPU 供應商介紹給廣達，占營收比重相對不高，ASIC 專案因此集中在少數客戶身上；公司不拆 x86 與 Arm 的比重，因為每個客戶分配給不同供應商的比例都不一樣，任何一個數字都無法代表整個市場。
非 NVIDIA 平台的比重由不到 10% 升到兩位數，改變的是廣達對單一晶片陣營的依賴程度，毛利率的方向不受影響。機櫃單價動輒數百萬美元，稀釋毛利率的是零組件金額占比；平台換成哪一家，對毛利的影響都小於對營收結構的影響。

paras_en: Nov 11, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) says its non‑NVIDIA platform accounted for less than 10% of revenue in 2026, and it expects that share to rise to a double‑digit percentage in 2027. Growth will be driven by cloud providers’ in‑house ASIC servers and AMD platforms, while NVIDIA remains the main supplier for the GPU track.

The platform generations are shifting. The company says shipments will gradually move from the current GB200 and GB300 cabinet generations to the VR200, and then to the next‑generation VR Ultra. After VR200, cabinet specs will include configurations with 72, 144 or 288 GPUs. Demand for GB300 and GB200 still exists, but “the mainstream is returning to the VR200 direction.”
AMD’s GPU platform is also an option. Quanta notes that AMD GPU shipments began in 2026 and will continue in 2027; however, on the GPU track customers still primarily choose NVIDIA.

The rise in non‑NVIDIA share is driven by AI‑agent applications boosting general‑purpose compute demand. Cloud providers are assigning more general‑purpose server projects to OEMs, leading to stronger‑than‑expected growth in general‑purpose servers in 2026. Shipments of both x86 and Arm architectures are increasing, with x86 slightly ahead; general‑purpose servers are still expected to grow at double‑digit rates in 2027.
Beyond the platform mix shift, revenue scale is also expanding. The company forecasts AI‑server revenue to maintain high double‑digit growth in 2027.

According to a chart from Youshi Analysis’s industry database, institutional investors on average project 2028 revenue of about NT$6.8 trillion and earnings per share of NT$36.22, which are 22% and 29% higher respectively than the 2027 figures of NT$5.59 trillion and NT$28.07.
Source: Youshi Analysis industry database.

Margin comparison must consider the whole cabinet system. Quanta explains that each customer’s project is different, so even for the same ASIC, gross‑margin structures vary across customers; generally, ASIC gross margins are not lower than those of general‑purpose servers.

The main customers remain the five large cloud service providers. Projects from newer cloud players (neocloud) are often introduced to Quanta by GPU vendors and represent a relatively small revenue share, so ASIC projects are concentrated among a few customers. The company does not break out x86 versus Arm shares because allocation ratios differ per customer, making any single figure unrepresentative of the market.

The rise of non‑NVIDIA platform share from under 10% to double‑digits changes Quanta’s reliance on a single chip camp but does not affect margin direction. Cabinet unit prices run into the hundreds of thousands of dollars, and component costs dilute margins; the choice of platform has a smaller impact on margin than on revenue structure.

items.title: 廣達(2382) 存貨增至 8,561 億元！資金集中在新世代機櫃的零件
items.title_en: Quanta (2382) Inventory Rises to NT$856.1 Billion! Capital Focused on Parts for Next‑Gen Server Racks
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 廣達(2382-TW) 第 3 季底存貨 8,561 億元，比第 2 季底增加 659 億元、季增 8.3%。公司說明，存貨增加是為了因應新世代 GPU 平台的 AI 伺服器機櫃在第 4 季進入小批量生產，高單價的關鍵零組件也陸續進料。
同一張資產負債表上，應收帳款也跟著放大。第 3 季底應收帳款 9,318 億元，比上一季底增加 21.7%、淨增約 1,660 億元。公司說明，應收帳款增加主要反映營業收入的成長；第 3 季合併營收 1.12 兆元、季增 7.6%，應收帳款的增幅高於營收。
存貨與應收帳款的絕對金額雙雙創下單季新高，週轉效率則變好。公司指出，整體現金週轉天數比 2025 年同期縮短逾 2 週；現金及短期投資 3,120 億元，比上一季末的 3,272 億元小幅下滑。
高單價機櫃占用資金營運資金的需求變大，原因在產品單價。公司表示，數百萬美元等級的 AI 機櫃讓關鍵零組件的金額占比放大，備料與應收的金額同時被推高，公司透過適度融資與多元籌資管道維持現金流的彈性。
2026 年 7 月底完成訂價、8 月初發行的海外存託憑證就是其中一筆。這次發行總金額 21.64 億美元、稀釋股權約 5.97%，公司公告的資金用途是支應外幣購料需求。
資金的成本也反映在業外。第 3 季淨利息費用 22.9 億元，比第 2 季的 16.9 億元增加；第 3 季淨匯兌收益 39 億元，其他業外收入 10.7 億元，三項合計的業外收支淨額約 26.8 億元。
公司表示，將持續控管存貨與應收帳款，並監控帳齡與帳款品質。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，存銷比是存貨除以近三個月營收，2026 年 9 月為 0.77 倍，近三個月營收合計 1.12 兆元，低於 2022 年的 0.99 倍，也低於 2025 年最高的 1.01 倍，顯示存貨金額變大是營收同步放大的結果。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
存貨 8,561 億元對應的是第 4 季要出貨的新世代機櫃，公司說明這是因應新機櫃進入小批量生產的備料。這筆備料能不能轉成營收，看的是新機櫃量產的節奏，以及客戶的提貨時間有沒有照原訂規劃走。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) reported third‑quarter ending inventory of NT$856.1 billion, up NT$65.9 billion from the second quarter, a quarterly increase of 8.3%. The company said the inventory buildup is to prepare for small‑batch production of next‑generation AI server racks based on new GPU platforms in Q4, with high‑priced key components being received gradually.

On the same balance sheet, accounts receivable also expanded. Quarter‑end accounts receivable stood at NT$931.8 billion, a 21.7% rise from the prior quarter and an increase of about NT$166 billion. The firm explained the rise mainly reflects revenue growth; Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$1.12 trillion, up 7.6% quarter‑over‑quarter, so receivables grew faster than sales.

Both the absolute amounts of inventory and receivables hit new quarterly highs, while turnover efficiency improved. The company noted that overall cash conversion days shortened by more than two weeks compared with the same period in 2025; cash and short‑term investments were NT$312 billion, slightly down from NT$327.2 billion at the end of the previous quarter.

High‑priced racks increase the demand for operating capital because of their unit price. Quanta said AI racks priced in the multi‑million‑dollar range amplify the share of key component costs, pushing up both material stocking and receivable amounts. The company maintains cash‑flow flexibility through moderate financing and diversified funding channels.

One of the financing actions was the overseas depositary receipt issued at the end of July 2026 and launched in early August. The issuance raised US$2.164 billion, diluting equity by about 5.97%, and the announced use of proceeds is to meet foreign‑currency material‑purchase needs.

The cost of capital also appears in non‑operating items. Net interest expense in Q3 was NT$2.29 billion, up from NT$1.69 billion in Q2; net foreign‑exchange gain was NT$390 million, and other non‑operating income was NT$1.07 billion, resulting in a combined non‑operating net inflow of roughly NT$2.68 billion.
The company said it will continue to manage inventory and receivables, and monitor aging and the quality of its receivables.

According to a chart from U‑Analysis’ industry database, the inventory‑to‑sales ratio (inventory divided by the last three months’ revenue) was 0.77× in September 2026, with three‑month revenue totaling NT$1.12 trillion, lower than the 0.99× ratio in 2022 and also below the 2025 peak of 1.01×, indicating that the larger inventory amount is a result of proportionally larger revenue.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

The NT$856.1 billion inventory corresponds to the next‑generation racks slated for shipment in Q4. Quanta explained this is material stocking for the small‑batch production of the new racks. Whether this stock converts to revenue depends on the pace of mass production and whether customers draw down their orders as originally scheduled.

items.title: 樺漢(6414) 2027 年在手訂單逾 2,800 億！一半來自半導體建廠
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 樺漢(6414-TW) 2027 年的在手訂單已超過 2,800 億元。公司表示，目前的訂單出貨比（BB ratio，當期接單金額除以出貨金額）為 1.3 至 1.35，換算下來，接單比出貨多出三成到三成五。
這批訂單有一半來自半導體建廠。公司指出，2,800 億元拆成兩軌、各佔一半：一軌是半導體廠務與智慧工廠，以下稱廠務那一軌；另一軌是工業物聯網與 AI 設備服務，以下稱本業。兩軌的訂單都排在 2027 年交付完畢。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，除了在手訂單，客戶先付進來的錢也反映能見度：合約負債（客戶預收款）2026 年第 2 季達 277 億元、佔單季營收 57%，近三年大致走高。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
到了第 3 季，數字再往上走：合約負債 311 億元、佔單季營收 64%，金額是 2017 年有這個數字以來的新高。
廠務那一軌的訂單主要來自子公司帆宣(6196-TW)。帆宣做的是半導體廠務工程、無塵室與設備整合，營收跟著晶圓廠的建廠進度認列。帆宣 9 月表示在手訂單約 1,351 億元，能見度至少延伸到 2028 年；帆宣在集團合併報表內，這批訂單已算在集團的 2,800 億元裡。
台積電(2330-TW) 11 月 10 日董事會通過約 409 億美元的資本預算、約新台幣 1.3 兆元，用途包含先進封裝產能、廠房興建與廠務設施工程。其中廠房興建與廠務設施工程的預算，正是帆宣這類廠務工程公司的訂單來源。
公司表示，2026 年廠務與先前投資的 KATEK 都受到影響：KATEK 與車廠的合作停頓、部分專案取消，基期因此偏低。由於基期不同，2027 年本業的成長幅度會高於廠務。
第 3 季本業毛利率 25.1%訂單能不能轉成獲利，關鍵在毛利率。2026 年前 3 季本業營收 766 億元、毛利 186 億元，毛利率約 24.4%，第 3 季進一步升到 25.1%。
廠務那一軌 2026 年前 3 季的平均毛利率是 13.2%，過去兩、三年都落在 9% 到 11% 之間。集團 2026 年前 3 季營收 1,340.7 億元，本業佔 57%、廠務佔 43%，加權後的毛利率為 19.6%，比 2025 年同期少 0.9 個百分點。
獲利節奏沒有變公司維持 2026 年全年獲利上半年佔 45%、下半年佔 55% 的分布；第 4 季的實際數字與公司自己的預算相比，不會有太大差異。
法人預估 2027 年營收 2,075 億元至 2,153 億元、每股盈餘 28.5 元至 34.14 元。2026 年前 3 季累計每股盈餘 20.18 元，公司表示這大約是歷史新高。
2,800 億元訂單是集團前 3 季營收的兩倍以上，且都排在 2027 年交付，能見度已經排到那一年。要讓集團毛利率 19.6% 往上走，關鍵在佔營收 43%、毛利率只有 13.2% 的廠務那一軌；2027 年這一軌的成長幅度低於本業，改善只能靠它自己的產品組合。
