items.title: CoreWeave財報報喜！AI雲端股大反攻 分析師卻提醒一大風險
items.title_en: CoreWeave Reports Strong Earnings! AI Cloud Stocks Rally, but Analysts Warn of a Major Risk
paras: 據《路透》周三(11日)報導，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁營收與融資策略調整，暫時緩解AI泡沫疑慮，股價上漲10%，帶動AI雲端股反彈。主要支持者輝達(NVDA-US)也漲5%，扭轉黃仁勳風波引發的連兩日跌勢。
CoreWeave上調全年營收預測，並表示，近期借款成本飆升後，將不再向無擔保債務市場籌資，現有合約產生的現金流足以支應當前及未來債務償付，回應市場對其舉債擴張的疑慮。
過去數周，投資人擔憂AI需求一旦放緩，仰賴負債擴建資料中心的業者將承受衝擊。民主黨上周期中選舉大勝，也增添監管變數，部分勝選者主張加強管制，甚至暫停新建資料中心，涵蓋德州等重要市場。
CoreWeave執行長Michael Intrator表示，審查趨嚴可能拖慢產業建設速度，但預期不會大幅改變公司擴張計畫或推升成本。
伯恩斯坦分析師Madison Rezaei團隊認為，這份財報幾乎符合最佳期待，營運數據強勁、融資疑慮獲得回應，策略也合理。不過，一旦AI算力供不應求的情況緩解，CoreWeave可能是最早且受創最重的業者之一。
投資時機錯配的風險已浮現。軟銀(9984-JP)周二針對美國資料中心設備的不可退還預付款認列37億美元減損，拖累第二季淨損達70億美元。
Nebius(NBIS-US)、Iren(IREN-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Applied Digital(APLD-US)盤前漲4.7%至11.8%。若漲勢維持，連同CoreWeave的雲端業者市值合計可望增加逾250億美元，輝達則約增2,100億美元。Nebius將於周四(12日)盤前公布財報。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Wednesday (the 11th), CoreWeave (CRWV-US) posted robust revenue and adjusted its financing strategy, temporarily easing concerns about an AI bubble. The stock rose 10%, sparking a rebound in AI cloud stocks. Its main backer Nvidia (NVDA-US) also gained 5%, reversing the two‑day decline triggered by the Jensen Huang controversy.

CoreWeave raised its full‑year revenue outlook and said that after a recent surge in borrowing costs it will no longer raise funds in the unsecured debt market. Cash flow from existing contracts is sufficient to cover current and future debt service, addressing market worries about debt‑driven expansion.

In recent weeks investors have feared that a slowdown in AI demand could hit companies that rely on debt‑financed data‑center builds. The Democrats’ big win in last week’s midterm elections adds regulatory uncertainty, as some winners are calling for tighter controls and even a pause on new data‑center construction in key markets such as Texas.
CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator said that tighter review could slow industry‑wide build‑out, but he does not expect it to materially alter the company’s expansion plans or drive up costs.

Bernstein analyst Madison Rezaei’s team believes the earnings almost met the best expectations, with strong operating metrics, financing concerns addressed, and a sensible strategy. However, if the shortage of AI compute power eases, CoreWeave could be one of the earliest and hardest‑hit players.

The risk of a timing mismatch in investment has already surfaced. SoftBank (9984-JP) on Tuesday recorded a $3.7 billion impairment on non‑refundable prepaid payments for U.S. data‑center equipment, dragging Q2 net loss to $7 billion.

Nebius (NBIS-US), Iren (IREN-US), Oracle (ORCL-US) and Applied Digital (APLD-US) were up 4.7% to 11.8% in pre‑market trading. If the rally holds, the combined market value of these cloud players plus CoreWeave could add more than $25 billion, while Nvidia could gain about $210 billion. Nebius will release its earnings in pre‑market trading on Thursday (the 12th).

items.title: 黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大！美國恐收緊輝達對中晶片出口管制、「3法案」通過機率飆升
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Affair Scandal Expands! U.S. Likely to Tighten Nvidia-China Chip Export Controls, "Three Bills" Passage Odds Surge
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳捲入婚外情及疑似中國情報人員相關風波，儘管輝達董事會已表態支持黃仁勳，美國國會跨黨派議員對他及輝達的信任卻出現動搖。分析指出，華府對此事的疑慮，預料將促使美國最快於下個月進一步收緊對輝達與中國業務往來的限制，國會議員也正準備舉行聽證會並展開調查。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，事實上，即使在間諜風波成為華府及華爾街焦點之前，針對中國取得部分輝達晶片的法案，就已經有機會透過年度國防法案在12月獲得國會通過。
多名分析師指出，如今這些法案透過這項「必須通過」的國防法案立法的可能性進一步提高。
Beacon Policy Advisors資深研究分析師Tedford指出，黃仁勳疑似涉及間諜事件，加上白宮承諾提出法案修正建議，使相關立法動能增強。不過，他認為法案仍非必然通過，即使最終獲得採納，內容也可能經過大幅調整，更接近白宮提出的版本。
目前受到關注的法案包括：

《晶片安全法案》（Chip Security Act），旨在遏止美國先進AI晶片遭非法走私至中國及其他敵對國家；
《AI監督法案》（AI Overwatch Act），則希望進一步收緊相關晶片的出口管制；
此外，《MATCH法案》也將針對敏感晶片製造設備加強出口限制。


報導指出，這些法案主要影響輝達，因為該公司掌握中國市場高度需求的最先進晶片。
上述三項法案都曾納入參議院今年稍早通過的國防授權法案版本，但未被眾議院版本採納。目前，參眾兩院協商代表正著手整合兩個版本的歧異，外界關注三項法案能否重新納入最終版本，讓國會兩院通過後，交由美國總統川普於下月簽署生效。
Veda Partners分析師Henrietta Treyz與Dan McCarthy指出，黃仁勳婚外情風波後，《晶片安全法案》立法機率已從原先的60%升至80%；《AI監督法案》從40%升至65%；《MATCH法案》則從35%提高至60%。
兩名分析師表示，接下來值得關注的是黃仁勳11月18日出席眾議院情報、外交事務及中國相關委員會閉門聽證會的情況，尤其是是否有證據顯示，川普政府的晶片與AI政策資訊曾洩漏給疑似中國情報人員、曾任新加坡雲端運算公司Megaspeed的高層黃樂（Alice Huang）。
至於川普政府是否進一步對輝達採取強硬措施，分析師認為可能性也有所上升，但幅度有限。最可能的做法是加強執法，打擊先進晶片走私至中國的行為。
另一種可能性較低的措施，是限制中國企業透過其他國家的資料中心遠端使用先進晶片。至於更激進的選項，包括撤銷輝達向中國出口H200晶片的許可，但分析師認為，考量川普與黃仁勳長期以來的關係，以及川普支持輝達發展的立場，短期內實施的可能性不高。
川普周一公開力挺黃仁勳，稱讚他「打造了一家很棒的公司」，並表示自己認為黃仁勳是非常正直的人，對他能妥善處理事件深具信心。川普也轉述，黃仁勳表示自己完全不知道相關人士是間諜。
輝達周日（8日）宣布，董事會正調查黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的鎖定目標。黃仁勳同日也在寄給員工的電子郵件中坦承對妻子不忠，並強調自己將致力於保護輝達及維護美國國家安全。
輝達股價周二（10日）下跌近6%，繼周一（9日）跌逾4%後持續走弱。今年以來股價累計下跌近10%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has become embroiled in an extramarital affair and alleged ties to Chinese intelligence operatives. Although Nvidia's board has voiced support for Huang, bipartisan members of the U.S. Congress are wavering in their trust of him and the company. Analysts say Washington's concerns are expected to prompt the United States to further tighten restrictions on Nvidia's dealings with China as early as next month, with lawmakers preparing hearings and investigations.

According to MarketWatch, even before the espionage scandal became a focus in Washington and on Wall Street, legislation aimed at restricting China's acquisition of certain Nvidia chips had a chance to pass Congress through the annual defense bill in December.
Several analysts note that the likelihood of these bills being enacted as part of the "must‑pass" defense legislation has now increased further.

Tedford, a senior research analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, said Huang's alleged involvement in an espionage incident, combined with the White House's pledge to propose amendments, has boosted legislative momentum. However, he cautioned that the bills are not guaranteed to pass and, even if adopted, could be substantially revised to align more closely with the White House's version.
The bills currently under scrutiny include:

The Chip Security Act, which aims to prevent advanced U.S. AI chips from being illegally smuggled to China and other hostile nations; the AI Overwatch Act, which seeks to tighten export controls on related chips; and the MATCH Act, which would tighten export restrictions on sensitive chip‑manufacturing equipment. The report notes that these measures primarily affect Nvidia, which holds the most advanced chips that are in high demand in the Chinese market.

All three proposals were incorporated into the version of the defense authorization bill that the Senate passed earlier this year, but were omitted from the House version. Lawmakers from both chambers are now working to reconcile the differences, and observers are watching to see whether the three bills will be re‑included in the final package that, if passed by both chambers, would be sent to President Trump for signing next month.

Veda Partners analysts Henrietta Treyz and Dan McCarthy said that after the affair scandal, the probability of the Chip Security Act being enacted rose from 60% to 80%; the AI Overwatch Act from 40% to 65%; and the MATCH Act from 35% to 60%.

The analysts added that attention will now turn to Huang's closed‑door testimony before the House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China committees on November 18, particularly whether evidence emerges that Trump administration chip and AI policy information was leaked to suspected Chinese intelligence operatives, including former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

As for whether the Trump administration will take tougher action against Nvidia, analysts say the likelihood has risen but any measures would be limited. The most probable step is increased enforcement to curb the smuggling of advanced chips to China.

A less likely option would be to restrict Chinese firms from remotely accessing advanced chips via data centers in other countries. A more aggressive possibility would be to revoke Nvidia's license to export H200 chips to China, but analysts note that, given Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Huang and his support for Nvidia’s growth, such a move is unlikely in the short term.

Trump publicly defended Huang on Monday, praising him for "building a great company" and saying he considers Huang a very upright person and is confident he can handle the situation properly. Trump also relayed that Huang said he had no knowledge that the individuals involved were spies.

Nvidia announced on Sunday (the 8th) that its board is investigating whether Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations. In an email to employees the same day, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and emphasized his commitment to protecting Nvidia and safeguarding U.S. national security.
Nvidia's shares fell nearly 6% on Tuesday (the 10th), extending a decline that saw the stock drop more than 4% on Monday (the 9th). The stock is down almost 10% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 美股開盤／CoreWeave大漲13%領軍AI股反彈 那斯達克漲1.6%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher / CoreWeave Jumps 13% Leading AI Stock Rebound, Nasdaq Up 1.6%
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股11日開盤走高，AI雲端運算業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)公布優於預期的第三季財報，並上調全年營收及營業利益財測，緩解市場對AI基礎建設投資回收的疑慮。CoreWeave開盤後大漲13%，帶動科技股反彈，那斯達克綜合指數上漲1.6%，標普500指數上漲近1%，道瓊工業指數則小漲45點，漲幅約0.1%。
CoreWeave近期成為市場檢視AI投資效益的重要指標。這家公司透過舉債擴建GPU運算基礎設施，再將算力提供給AI企業與雲端客戶使用。隨著市場開始擔心資料中心建置進度放緩，以及龐大資本支出何時能轉為獲利，CoreWeave股價先前承受明顯賣壓。不過，最新財報營收優於分析師預期，公司也提高2026年營收與營業利益展望，並預期2028年上半年可達成調整後獲利，讓市場重新評估其成長前景。
投資市場對AI投資的態度已從過去普遍看好資本支出增加，轉向更重視實際投資報酬。CoreWeave先前正是這波疑慮下的代表性個股，而最新財報與獲利展望暫時減輕市場擔憂，也為近期跌深的AI基礎建設類股帶來反彈機會。
輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)開盤後上漲約3%，扭轉本週前兩個交易日累計近10%的跌幅，有助於減輕大型科技股賣壓。

AI基礎建設相關股票在盤前已率先反彈，其中Nebius Group(NBIS-US)一度上漲13.9%，Applied Digital(APLD-US)上漲10.1%；半導體業者邁威爾Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)、美光Micron(MU-US)則分別上漲9.1%及7.4%。儲存設備業者希捷Seagate Technology(STX-US)及威騰電子Western Digital(WDC-US)盤前漲幅也達9.5%及8.6%，顯示資金回流範圍涵蓋雲端運算、晶片及資料儲存供應鏈。
不過，科技股反彈之際，美國通膨與升息壓力仍未解除。美國10月消費者物價指數（CPI）月增0.4%，高於市場預期的0.3%，使投資人更加確信聯準會將於12月升息。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場預估12月升息1碼的機率已提高至約90%，利率前景仍可能影響科技股評價，以及高度依賴外部融資的資料中心業者。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. equities opened higher on the 11th. AI cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) posted a third‑quarter earnings report that beat expectations and raised its full‑year revenue and operating‑income forecasts, easing market concerns about the payback of AI infrastructure investments. CoreWeave surged 13% after the open, pulling tech stocks higher; the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.6%, the S&P 500 climbed nearly 1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average inched up about 45 points, roughly 0.1%.

CoreWeave has recently become a key barometer for assessing AI investment returns. The company finances the expansion of GPU‑compute infrastructure through debt and then sells compute capacity to AI firms and cloud customers. As the market began to worry about a slowdown in data‑center build‑out and when large capital outlays might turn profitable, CoreWeave’s share price had been under clear selling pressure. However, the latest earnings showed revenue above analysts’ estimates, and the company lifted its 2026 revenue and operating‑income outlook, also projecting adjusted profitability by the first half of 2028, prompting the market to re‑evaluate its growth prospects.

Investors’ attitude toward AI spending has shifted from a broad optimism about rising capex to a stronger focus on actual investment returns. CoreWeave was a representative stock of the earlier wave of doubt, and the new earnings and profit outlook have temporarily eased market concerns, offering a rebound opportunity for AI‑infrastructure stocks that have recently fallen deep.
NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) rose about 3% after the open, reversing nearly 10% of the losses accumulated over the previous two trading days, helping to relieve selling pressure on large‑cap tech stocks.

AI‑infrastructure‑related stocks were already bouncing in pre‑market trading: Nebius Group (NBIS‑US) at one point jumped 13.9%, Applied Digital (APLD‑US) rose 10.1%; semiconductor makers Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) climbed 9.1% and 7.4% respectively. Storage‑equipment companies Seagate Technology (STX‑US) and Western Digital (WDC‑US) were also up 9.5% and 8.6% in pre‑market, showing that capital is flowing back across the cloud‑computing, chip and data‑storage supply chain.

Nevertheless, as tech stocks rebound, U.S. inflation and rate‑hike pressures remain unresolved. October’s U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above the 0.3% market expectation, reinforcing investors’ belief that the Federal Reserve will raise rates in December. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a one‑basis‑point rate hike in December has risen to about 90%, and the interest‑rate outlook could still affect tech‑stock valuations and data‑center operators that rely heavily on external financing.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Rise Early: CoreWeave Earnings Boost; Nasdaq Leads, TSMC ADR Up Over 4%
paras: 美股主要指數周三(11日)開盤走高，那斯達克指數領漲。AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁財報提振市場對人工智慧(AI)需求的信心，暫時緩解投資人對支出過度擴張的疑慮，帶動科技股反彈。
輝達(NVDA-US)也在連續兩個交易日下跌後回升，市場重新押注，支撐美股多頭行情的AI投資熱潮仍有延續空間。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數跌近90點或近0.2%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近410點或近1.6%，標普 500 指數漲近1.0%，費城半導體指數漲近4.3%，台積電ADR漲近4.1%。
CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁財報與Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)熱絡需求，帶動資金重返AI概念股，美股期貨走高。那斯達克100指數期貨上漲2%，標普500指數期貨上漲1%，但升息預期升溫，仍限制整體市場的上漲空間。

AI需求數據提振信心 CoreWeave盤前大漲15%

先前遭重挫的AI雲端業者CoreWeave公布強勁營收成長，緩解市場對其高負債營運模式的疑慮，盤前股價大漲15%，帶動Nebius(NBIS-US)等同業及AI基礎建設類股同步走高。輝達(NVDA-US)也有望迎來執行長黃仁勳風波爆發後的首個上漲交易日。
其他企業數據同樣顯示AI需求仍強。OpenAI單季營收首度達到100億美元；知情人士則透露，Anthropic的IPO認購訂單已達可供發售股數的數倍，為近期承壓的AI投資題材增添支撐。
美國期中選舉結果出爐後，AI類股一度面臨沉重賣壓。CoreWeave最新業績則顯示，即使資料中心產業面臨挑戰，營收仍維持強勁成長。
貝倫貝格銀行的Ulrich Urbahn表示，這波AI行情回升有實際需求作為依據：CoreWeave第三季業績優於預期，並上調全年展望。他指出，相關股票估值已明顯降低，促使投資人重新建立部位。
不過，IPO熱潮也引發估值疑慮。Anthropic預計最快於下周接近周末時開始交易，創投公司Copper Sky的Jack Selby警告，這場IPO可能成為AI行情大幅反轉的觸媒，日後閉鎖期屆滿、限售股解禁，也可能對股價形成壓力。
Selby接受《彭博》電視訪問時表示，AI業務極度仰賴資本支出，雖然確實存在商業價值，但仍處於發展初期，將Anthropic視為價值1兆美元的企業，在他看來過於牽強。

升息預期限制漲勢 油價回升與歐股走強

AI類股反彈之際，利率前景仍是市場阻力。升息預期升溫限制美股整體漲幅，美元上漲0.3%。美國公債現貨市場因退伍軍人節休市，但衍生性商品交易顯示，美債價格可能延續周二跌勢。
油價則止住連續兩天下跌，布蘭特原油回升至接近每桶93美元。伊朗一名高階官員排除放棄濃縮鈾的可能性，顯示美伊立場仍存在明顯分歧。
歐洲方面，科技與能源類股領漲，泛歐Stoxx 600指數上漲0.4%；區域公債價格也回升，以法國與義大利公債表現領先。根據《彭博》彙整數據，以美元計算，歐股基準指數本季迄今報酬率領先標普500逾3個百分點。
傑富瑞(JEF-US)的Mohit Kumar表示，相較美股，投資人目前仍低配歐股，偏低的持股比重可能提供後續支撐。他指出，該行正尋找科技題材以外的資金輪動機會，除了美國其他類股，也將投資分散至歐洲與新興市場。
Kumar補充，該行部位指標顯示，股票與信用市場部位均接近中性，這也是其看好風險性資產的原因之一。
《彭博》總體策略師Conor Cooper則認為，歐股朝歷史收盤新高邁進，企業財報與經濟前景仍提供支撐。聯準會(Fed)立場若更偏鷹派，也未必全然不利歐股，因為美元走強可能有利歐洲出口商。

AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) posted a strong earnings report that lifted market confidence in AI demand and temporarily eased investors' concerns about over‑expansion of spending, sparking a rebound in tech stocks.
Nvidia (NVDA-US) also recovered after two consecutive days of declines, as the market once again bets on the AI investment boom that underpins the bullish U.S. equity trend.

AI demand data boosted confidence – CoreWeave surged 15% pre‑market. After a sharp previous decline, CoreWeave reported robust revenue growth, easing worries about its high‑debt operating model, and its pre‑market price jumped 15%, lifting peers such as Nebius (NBIS-US) and other AI infrastructure stocks. Nvidia (NVDA-US) also looked set for its first rally day since CEO Jensen Huang’s controversy erupted.

Other company data also showed that AI demand remains strong. OpenAI’s quarterly revenue topped $10 billion for the first time; sources said Anthropic’s IPO orders were several times the number of shares on offer, adding support to the AI investment theme that had been under pressure.

After the U.S. mid‑term election results were released, AI stocks faced heavy selling pressure. CoreWeave’s latest results showed that even as data‑center industry challenges persist, its revenue continued to grow strongly.

Ulrich Urbahn of Berenberg Bank said the AI rally is backed by real demand: CoreWeave’s third‑quarter results beat expectations and the company raised its full‑year outlook. He noted that valuations for related stocks have fallen markedly, prompting investors to rebuild positions.

However, the IPO frenzy also raises valuation concerns. Anthropic is expected to begin trading as early as next weekend. Jack Selby of venture firm Copper Sky warned that the IPO could become a catalyst for a sharp reversal in the AI rally, and that the eventual lock‑up expiry and share‑release could put downward pressure on the price.

In a Bloomberg TV interview, Selby said AI businesses are heavily reliant on capital spending. While there is genuine commercial value, the sector is still in its early stages, and valuing Anthropic at a $1 trillion enterprise is, in his view, overly optimistic.

Rising rate‑hike expectations are curbing the rally, while oil prices rebound and European stocks strengthen. Even as AI stocks bounce, the outlook for interest rates remains a market drag. Higher rate‑hike expectations are limiting overall U.S. equity gains, and the dollar rose 0.3%. The U.S. Treasury spot market was closed for Veterans Day, but derivatives indicate Treasury prices may continue Tuesday’s decline.
Oil prices halted a two‑day slide, with Brent climbing back toward $93 a barrel. A senior Iranian official ruled out abandoning enriched uranium, underscoring continued U.S.–Iran tensions.

Bloomberg data show that, measured in dollars, European equity benchmarks have outperformed the S&P 500 by more than three percentage points so far this quarter.

Mohit Kumar of Jefferies (JEF-US) said that, compared with U.S. equities, investors are still underweight European stocks, and the low allocation could provide future support. He added that the firm is seeking capital‑rotation opportunities outside of tech themes, diversifying not only into other U.S. sectors but also into Europe and emerging markets.
Kumar further noted that the firm’s position indicators show its equity and credit exposures are near neutral, which is one reason it remains bullish on risk assets.

Bloomberg’s chief strategist Conor Cooper believes European markets are moving toward fresh all‑time highs, with corporate earnings and economic outlook still providing support. Even if the Fed adopts a more hawkish stance, it may not be wholly detrimental to Europe, as a stronger dollar could benefit European exporters.

items.title: 美光看起來超便宜？高盛：挑記憶體股別只看本益比
items.title_en: Micron looks ultra cheap? Goldman Sachs: When selecting memory stocks, only look at the P/E ratio
paras: 美光(MU-US)股價歷經一個月重挫後，開始吸引逢低買盤，周三(11日)盤前上漲6.2%，報769.74美元。不過，高盛(GS-US)認為，近期記憶體股賣壓過後，南韓同業SK海力士(SKHY-US)(000660-KS)與三星電子(005930-KS)的估值更具吸引力，仍是該行較偏好的投資標的。
據《巴隆》報導，市場擔憂民主黨主導的資料中心反對聲浪可能拖慢人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮，美光過去一個月累計下跌21%。雖然股價修正使其預估本益比顯得相當便宜，但對於景氣循環明顯的記憶體產業，低本益比未必代表低估。
質疑者指出，記憶體公司在景氣高峰時獲利大增，往往會讓本益比看起來偏低；一旦景氣反轉、獲利大幅下滑，原先看似便宜的估值就可能失去支撐。因此，高盛分析師James Schneider及其團隊更偏好以股價相對「有形帳面價值」的倍數評估這個產業。
有形帳面價值是從帳面淨值中扣除商譽與其他無形資產後的數值，屬於較保守的資產衡量方式，可粗略用來評估公司清算後股東可能取得的剩餘價值，但不代表實際清算時一定能回收的金額。
Schneider在本周研究報告中指出，全球記憶體股過去往往在接近有形帳面價值時觸底，目前已有數家公司的估值開始接近這些水準，其中三星與SK海力士的股價已低於各自每股帳面淨值。不過，低於帳面淨值與低於扣除無形資產後的有形帳面價值，仍是不同概念。
高盛對SK海力士與三星均給予「買進」評等，但投資管道也會影響實際買進成本。以SK海力士為例，其美國存託憑證(ADR)周三上漲約8%，交易價格卻較南韓掛牌股票溢價逾40%，投資人若透過ADR布局，未必能取得與韓股相同的估值優勢。
相較之下，高盛估算，美光股價仍約為有形帳面價值的5.4倍，Schneider因此維持「中立」評等。不過，他給予的目標價仍高達1,250美元，顯示即使美光並非該行首選，仍被認為具有可觀的上漲空間。
Schneider表示，考量美光未來幾季極有可能產生強勁的自由現金流，該股的風險報酬已變得更具吸引力。高盛的立場因此並非全面看空美光，而是在記憶體股修正後，仍較看好三星與SK海力士的相對估值。
paras_en: Micron (MU-US) stock price after a month of steep decline begins attracting buying on dips, up 6.2% pre‑market Wednesday (the 11th) at $769.74. However Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) believes that after recent selling pressure in memory stocks, South Korean peers SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) (000660‑KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS) have more attractive valuations and remain the firm’s preferred investment targets.

According to Barron’s, the market worries that Democrat‑led data‑center opposition could slow the AI investment boom, and Micron has fallen 21% over the past month. Although the price correction makes its forward P/E appear very cheap, for the clearly cyclical memory industry a low P/E does not necessarily indicate undervaluation.

Critics note that memory companies see profit surges at cyclical peaks, making P/E look low; once the cycle reverses and earnings drop sharply, the seemingly cheap valuation can lose support. Therefore Goldman analysts James Schneider and his team prefer evaluating the industry using the price multiple relative to tangible book value.

Tangible book value is the net book value after subtracting goodwill and other intangibles, a more conservative asset measure, roughly used to assess the residual value shareholders might obtain after liquidation, but it does not guarantee the actual recoverable amount in liquidation.

Schneider said in this week’s research report that global memory stocks have historically bottomed when approaching tangible book value; several companies are now near those levels, with Samsung and SK Hynix trading below their respective book value per share. However, being below book value and being below tangible book value after removing intangibles are different concepts.

Goldman gives “Buy” ratings to SK Hynix and Samsung, but investment channels affect actual purchase cost. For SK Hynix, its ADR rose about 8% on Wednesday, yet trades at a premium of over 40% to the Korean‑listed shares; investors using ADRs may not capture the same valuation advantage as with the Korean stock.

By contrast, Goldman estimates Micron’s price is still about 5.4 times its tangible book value, so Schneider maintains a “Neutral” rating. Nevertheless, his target price remains as high as $1,250, indicating that even though Micron is not the firm’s top pick, it is still seen as having considerable upside.

Schneider said that considering Micron could generate strong free cash flow in the coming quarters, the stock’s risk‑reward profile has become more attractive. Goldman’s stance is therefore not a blanket bearish view on Micron, but after the memory‑stock correction it still prefers the relative valuations of Samsung and SK Hynix.

根據《路透》報導，根據西北工業大學官網10月21日公布的採購紀錄，這所被列入中國「國防七子」的國防領域重點大學，上個月以87.47萬元人民幣（約12.3萬美元）購入兩顆H200晶片。
採購紀錄顯示，這批晶片是由該校管理學院向陝西博算網路科技公司購入，而非直接向輝達採購。
H200是輝達性能最強大的AI晶片之一，可用於訓練及執行先進AI系統，出口須取得美國政府許可。對於西北工業大學這類遭列入黑名單的機構，美國通常會拒絕核發相關出口許可。
採購紀錄也顯示，西北工業大學今年透過與中國企業簽訂的五份運算資源租用合約，取得H200及其他高效能輝達AI處理器的使用權。
這項調查結果出爐之際，輝達及執行長黃仁勳正面臨華府日益升高的審查壓力。此前有報導指黃仁勳遭中國間諜行動鎖定，加上他持續遊說美國放寬對中AI晶片銷售限制，使相關爭議進一步升溫。
黃仁勳主張，持續向中國銷售美國晶片，有助於維持美國的技術領先地位，也能讓中國客戶繼續依賴美國技術。
不過，美國部分國會議員認為，讓中國取得輝達最強大的AI晶片，可能加速中國將AI應用於武器設計、情報分析及軍事現代化。
美國國會民主、共和兩黨議員均呼籲加強管制中國取得先進AI晶片，包括要求追蹤晶片流向，以及提高國會對晶片出口的監督力度。三名共和黨籍國會委員會主席已要求黃仁勳於11月18日出席簡報會，說明他據報與一名涉嫌中國情報人員的接觸情況。

中國西北工業大學被列入美國貿易黑名單

西北工業大學位於中國西北部城市西安，研究領域涉及軍用飛機、飛彈及衛星。
美國商務部2001年以該校涉嫌參與飛彈擴散活動及軍事研究為由，將其列入貿易黑名單「實體清單」。2019年，美國進一步收緊限制，規定向該校出口受管制的美國技術，在大多數情況下均採取拒絕核發許可的政策。
《路透》指出，西北工業大學的採購情況表明，與中國軍方有關聯的機構，仍能透過本土供應商取得美國AI運算能力，不論是直接購買晶片，或租用搭載相關晶片的伺服器。
此外，《路透》檢視今年中國26份政府採購及企業紀錄發現，多所大學與研究機構透過本土供應商購買受到美國出口限制的輝達晶片，或租用採用這些晶片的輝達運算服務，其中數所機構與中國國防產業或軍事研究關係密切。

黑名單大學仍取得多款受限晶片運算資源

美國總統川普政府今年1月開始，逐案批准部分H200晶片出口至中國，但這項政策並未解除實體清單機構所面臨的獨立限制，西北工業大學仍在適用範圍內。
1月公布的出口許可規定，也要求採取防護措施，避免遭列入黑名單的機構及軍事終端用戶，透過遠端方式使用依照該政策出口的晶片。相關政策涵蓋H200及性能較低的其他型號。
除了管理學院直接購入兩顆H200晶片，採購紀錄還顯示，西北工業大學網路空間安全學院今年1月決標兩份為期7個月的合約，租用搭載H200晶片的伺服器，每台伺服器各包含8顆H200。兩份合約金額分別為44.17萬元及44.1萬元人民幣，服務用途包括AI模型微調及強化學習訓練。
同時，該校也租用了搭載8顆輝達A100晶片及8顆A800晶片的伺服器。A100與A800均禁止出口至中國任何實體，不過，H200仍是西北工業大學採購紀錄中提及的性能最先進晶片。
今年4月，西北工業大學內另一所研究機構也以37.5萬元人民幣採購運算服務，合約要求至少提供24顆A100晶片，用於結構力學及流體動力學模擬。
這些合約由數家知名度不高的中國科技供應商得標，但採購紀錄幾乎沒有提供晶片來源，以及租用伺服器實際運作地點的資訊。
根據中國法律，政府採購機構必須在公布得標廠商及簽訂合約前，確認供應商有能力履行訂單。

受限輝達晶片在中國大學市場持續流通

採購紀錄也顯示，受美國出口限制的輝達AI晶片及運算服務，在中國大學市場形成更廣泛的供應管道。
深圳大學9月以76.98萬元人民幣購入3顆H100晶片，這款高階AI晶片同樣遭美國禁止出口至中國。武漢理工大學則在6月以35.5萬元人民幣購入一台搭載H100晶片的伺服器，另外也以34.4萬元人民幣採購4顆A100晶片。
同屬中國「國防七子」的北京航空航天大學，今年4月以48.9萬元人民幣購入4顆A800處理器。北京航空航天大學與中國航空航太及國防產業關係密切，研究工作涉及軍用航空及太空計畫。
另外，中國科學院大學7月及9月公布的兩份政府採購公告，列出獲選提供運算服務的供應商，相關服務使用遭美國限制出口至中國的輝達H800及A800晶片。其中一份公告列出的H800運算服務價格為每顆晶片每小時10元人民幣。
另一份今年1月的採購決標公告則列出一家供應商，將向深圳一所公共機構提供6顆A100晶片，合約金額為48.48萬元人民幣。
《路透》先前也曾報導，中國機構透過本土經銷商，取得搭載於美超微電腦(SMCI-US) 、戴爾科技(DELL-US) 及技嘉(2376-TW) 伺服器中的受限輝達晶片。
此外，該媒體也曾揭露中國存在受限輝達晶片的地下交易市場，貨源來自海外庫存及第三國中間商。
paras_en: Northwest University of Technology, a school closely tied to the People’s Liberation Army and already on the US export‑control blacklist, still bought Nvidia (NVDA-US) high‑end AI chip H200 last month through a domestic Chinese supplier for 874,700 yuan (about $123,000), highlighting gaps in Washington’s attempts to curb China’s access to advanced technology.

According to Reuters, the procurement record posted on Northwest University of Technology’s website on October 21 shows that the university, listed among China’s “Seven Defense Sons” and a key institution in the defence sector, purchased two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan (about $123,000).
The record indicates the chips were bought by the university’s School of Management from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology Co., not directly from Nvidia.

The H200 is one of Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips, usable for training and running advanced AI systems, and its export requires US government approval. For entities like Northwest University of Technology that are on the blacklist, the US typically denies such export licences.

The procurement data also shows that this year the university secured usage rights to the H200 and other high‑performance Nvidia AI processors through five computing‑resource lease contracts signed with Chinese firms.

The findings emerge as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny from Washington. Earlier reports said Huang was targeted by Chinese espionage efforts and that his lobbying for looser US AI‑chip sales restrictions to China has intensified the controversy.
Huang argues that continued sales of US chips to China help maintain America’s technological lead and keep Chinese customers dependent on US technology.
However, some US lawmakers warn that letting China obtain Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips could accelerate the use of AI in weapons design, intelligence analysis and military modernisation.

Democratic and Republican members of Congress alike are calling for tighter controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, including tracking chip flows and strengthening congressional oversight of chip exports. Three Republican committee chairs have asked Huang to appear at a briefing on November 18 to explain reports of his contact with a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.
Northwest University of Technology is on the US trade blacklist. The university, located in Xi’an in north‑western China, conducts research on military aircraft, missiles and satellites.

The US Department of Commerce added the school to the Entity List in 2001 over alleged involvement in missile proliferation and military research. In 2019 the US tightened restrictions, generally refusing licences for exporting controlled US technology to the school.

Reuters notes that the university’s purchases show that institutions linked to the Chinese military can still obtain US AI computing power via domestic suppliers, whether by buying chips outright or leasing servers equipped with them.

Reuters also examined 26 Chinese government and corporate procurement records this year and found that many universities and research institutes bought restricted Nvidia chips or leased Nvidia computing services through local vendors, with several of those entities closely tied to China’s defence industry or military research.

Blacklist‑listed universities have still obtained multiple restricted‑chip computing resources. The Trump administration began approving case‑by‑case exports of some H200 chips to China in January, but the policy did not lift the separate restrictions that apply to Entity‑List entities, so Northwest University of Technology remained subject to them.

The January export‑licence rules also required protective measures to prevent blacklisted entities and military end‑users from remotely accessing chips exported under the policy. The rules cover the H200 and lower‑performance models as well.

Beyond the School of Management’s direct purchase of two H200 chips, the procurement record shows that the university’s School of Cyberspace Security awarded two seven‑month contracts in January to lease servers equipped with H200 chips, each server containing eight H200s. The contracts were valued at 441,700 yuan and 441,000 yuan respectively, for AI model fine‑tuning and reinforcement‑learning training.

At the same time, the university also leased servers equipped with eight Nvidia A100 chips and eight A800 chips. Both the A100 and A800 are prohibited from export to any entity in China, yet the H200 remains the most advanced chip mentioned in the university’s procurement records.

In April, another research institute within Northwest University of Technology bought computing services for 375,000 yuan, with the contract requiring at least 24 A100 chips for structural mechanics and fluid‑dynamics simulations.

These contracts were awarded to several little‑known Chinese tech suppliers, but the procurement records provide little information about the chips’ origin or the physical location of the leased servers.
Under Chinese law, government‑procurement agencies must verify a supplier’s ability to fulfil an order before publishing the winning vendor and signing the contract.

Restricted Nvidia chips continue to circulate in China’s university market. Procurement records also show that US export‑controlled Nvidia AI chips and computing services have formed a broader supply channel in the Chinese higher‑education sector.

Shenzhen University bought three H100 chips in September for 769,800 yuan; the high‑end AI chip is also banned from export to China. Wuhan University of Technology purchased a server with an H100 chip in June for 355,000 yuan and also bought four A100 chips for 344,000 yuan.

Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, another of China’s “Seven Defense Sons,” bought four A800 processors in April for 489,000 yuan. The university has close ties to China’s aerospace and defence industry, with research covering military aviation and space programmes.

In July and September, the Chinese Academy of Sciences announced two government procurement notices listing suppliers selected to provide computing services that use Nvidia H800 and A800 chips, which are subject to US export restrictions. One notice priced H800 computing services at 10 yuan per chip per hour.
A January procurement notice listed a supplier that will provide six A100 chips to a public institution in Shenzhen, under a contract worth 484,800 yuan.

Reuters previously reported that Chinese organisations obtain restricted Nvidia chips installed in servers from Super Micro Computer (SMCI‑US), Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) through domestic distributors.
The outlet also uncovered an underground market in China for restricted Nvidia chips, with supply coming from overseas stockpiles and third‑country intermediaries.

items.title: 輝達比大盤還便宜！估值探15年低點 是買點還是接刀？
items.title_en: Nvidia Cheaper Than the Market! Valuation Hits 15-Year Low – Buying Opportunity or a Trap?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價重挫後，未來12個月預估本益比降至不到12倍，創15年來最低，甚至低於標普500指數。部分華爾街人士認為，強勁成長前景讓輝達的投資吸引力浮現，但低估值也反映另一層疑慮：市場是否仍相信獲利預測，以及執行長黃仁勳能否繼續掌舵。
綜合外媒報導，輝達周三(11日)盤前一度上漲3%，報173.99美元，但過去一個月已下跌24%。黃仁勳承認與一名被指涉及對中間諜活動的女子有婚外情後，股價本周跌勢加深，領導階層的不確定性也成為投資人重新評估公司的關鍵。

本益比跌破12倍 低於大盤的便宜有何代價

根據FactSet數據，輝達未來12個月預估本益比降至11.77倍，為2011年以來最低，標普500指數同期則約18倍。換言之，投資人為輝達每1美元預期獲利支付的價格，已不到12美元。
然而，這項估值建立在預期獲利能夠實現的前提上。外媒指出，問題在於輝達究竟遭到低估，還是投資人開始質疑那些讓股價顯得便宜的獲利預測。
輝達股價在黃仁勳風波爆發前就已走弱，如今他的去留又增添變數。因此，預估本益比降至低點，並不等於市場已認定股價觸底。

瑞穗砍目標價仍看高成長 基金經理人認為行情未完

瑞穗分析師Vijay Rakesh將輝達目標價從315美元下修至250美元，但仍認為黃仁勳留任的可能性較高。他指出，黃仁勳離職是輝達面臨的主要風險，不過，考量其關鍵創辦人與領導者地位，以及董事會的強力支持，這項風險可望受到抑制。
Rakesh的250美元目標價，是以2028會計年度預估獲利的16倍本益比計算；該會計年度大致對應2027曆年。他預期，輝達該年度營收與獲利均將成長逾70%，因此認為這樣的估值要求並不高。
這項目標價採用的獲利期間，與目前11.77倍本益比所依據的未來12個月不同，兩者不能直接視為同一期間的估值比較。
持有輝達股票的Gunderson Capital Management總裁Bill Gunderson則表示，從估值角度來看，他認為目前市場上沒有比輝達更便宜的成長股。他以棒球比賽比喻，這波行情可能才進行到九局中的第三、第四局，後面仍有發展空間。

獲利能否兌現 黃仁勳去留與融資環境成考驗

看多論點能否成立，仍取決於公司成長與領導穩定性。輝達周二宣布，由Wachtell Lipton律師事務所主導獨立調查，前聯邦檢察官Joon Kim負責，釐清公司是否成為外國間諜活動的目標。
董事會周日表示，目前沒有理由相信公司機密或國家安全因黃仁勳的婚外情而受到危害。不過，輝達沒有明顯的接班人選，黃仁勳過去也曾公開否定接班規劃的必要性，且直接向他報告的主管範圍異常廣泛。該刊先前主張，除非黃仁勳被迫離職，否則輝達仍值得持有。
總體環境則是另一項風險。高於預期的通膨數據推升更大幅度升息的可能性，2年期美債殖利率周二出現2025年4月以來最大單日升幅，可能進一步提高AI產業融資成本。
聯準會(Fed)金融監管副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)也警告，今年AI相關債務規模預計將超過8,000億美元，企業透過貸款、投資與財務擔保形成愈來愈緊密的連結。若龐大投資未能帶來預期回報，衝擊可能擴散至科技業以外的企業與消費者。
輝達將於11月17日公布財報。對投資人而言，判斷低估值是否構成機會，關鍵仍是後續業績能否支撐獲利預期，以及公司能否降低領導階層的不確定性。
paras_en: After Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares plunged, its forward 12‑month price‑to‑earnings ratio is projected to fall below 12×, the lowest in 15 years and even lower than the S&P 500. Some Wall Street voices say strong growth prospects revive Nvidia’s appeal, but the low valuation also raises a question: does the market still believe the earnings forecasts and can CEO Jensen Huang continue to steer the ship?

According to foreign media, Nvidia briefly rose 3% to $173.99 in pre‑market trading on Wednesday (the 11th) before falling 24% over the past month. Huang’s admission of an affair with a woman alleged to be involved in espionage against China deepened the stock’s weekly decline, and leadership uncertainty has become a key factor for investors reassessing the company.

Forward P/E drops below 12× – what’s the price of cheapness compared with the broader market? FactSet data shows Nvidia’s forward 12‑month P/E is expected to fall to 11.77×, the lowest since 2011, while the S&P 500’s forward P/E is about 18×. In other words, investors are paying less than $12 for each $1 of expected earnings from Nvidia.

However, this valuation rests on the assumption that the earnings forecasts will materialise. Foreign reports point out the issue: is Nvidia truly undervalued, or are investors beginning to doubt the profit projections that make the stock appear cheap?

Nvidia’s share price was already weakening before the Huang scandal broke, and his possible departure now adds another variable. Therefore, a projected low forward P/E does not mean the market has confirmed a bottom.

Mizuho cut its target price but still sees high growth. Analyst Vijay Rakesh lowered Nvidia’s target from $315 to $250, yet he believes Huang is likely to stay. He notes that Huang’s exit would be Nvidia’s biggest risk, but given Huang’s role as founder and leader and strong board support, that risk should be contained.

Rakesh’s $250 target is based on a 16× P/E applied to earnings projected for fiscal 2028, which roughly aligns with calendar year 2027. He expects revenue and earnings that year to grow more than 70%, so he views that valuation as modest.
The earnings period used for that target differs from the 12‑month forward P/E of 11.77×, so the two valuations cannot be directly compared as covering the same timeframe.

Bill Gunderson, president of Gunderson Capital Management, said that from a valuation standpoint he sees no cheaper growth stock than Nvidia in the market today. He likened the rally to a baseball game that is only in the third or fourth inning of the ninth, suggesting there is still room to develop.

Whether bullish arguments hold depends on the company’s growth and leadership stability. Nvidia announced on Tuesday that an independent investigation, led by law firm Wachtell Lipton and former federal prosecutor Joon Kim, will examine whether the company has become a target of foreign espionage.

The board said on Sunday there is no reason to believe company secrets or national security have been compromised by Huang’s affair. However, Nvidia lacks a clear successor; Huang has previously dismissed the need for a succession plan, and his reporting span is unusually broad. The publication previously argued that unless Huang is forced out, Nvidia remains a hold.

The broader environment is another risk. Higher‑than‑expected inflation data raise the odds of larger rate hikes, and two‑year U.S. Treasury yields jumped the biggest single‑day increase since April 2025 on Tuesday, potentially raising financing costs for the AI sector.

Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman warned that AI‑related debt could exceed $800 billion this year, tightening the link between corporate borrowing, investment and financial guarantees. If massive investments fail to deliver expected returns, the fallout could spread beyond tech firms to other companies and consumers.

Nvidia will release its earnings on November 17. For investors, deciding whether the low valuation is an opportunity hinges on whether upcoming results can support earnings expectations and whether the company can reduce leadership uncertainty.

items.title: CoreWeave預告轉虧為盈帶動AI股反彈那斯達克期貨漲1.9%
items.title_en: CoreWeave Forecasts Turnaround to Profit, Boosting AI Stocks as Nasdaq Futures Rise 1.9%
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股11月11日盤前科技股反彈，AI雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)提出轉虧為盈的時程，緩解市場對龐大AI投資能否帶來獲利的疑慮。截至目前為止，標普500期貨上漲0.91%，那斯達克100期貨上漲1.98%，道瓊期貨小漲0.16%，科技股表現領先。
CoreWeave預期，2028年上半年將以調整後基礎轉為獲利，盤前股價大漲逾15%。公司試圖以強勁需求及客戶承諾，說明透過舉債推動擴張的可行性。市場持續關注資料中心建置速度與資金成本，轉盈時程也成為投資人評估AI基礎建設投資的焦點。
晶片股盤前同步回升。輝達(NVDA-US)上漲3.75%，在前兩個交易日市值合計蒸發約4,300億美元後反彈；邁威爾(MRVL-US)與美光(MU-US)分別上漲8.76%及6.52%。
利率仍是市場關注的壓力。美國10月消費者物價漲幅高於預期，食品與住宿成本上升，加深市場對聯準會12月升息的預期。依CME FedWatch數據，交易員當時已完全反映下月升息，升息兩碼的機率為11.5%。美國債市當天因退伍軍人節休市。

items.title: CoreWeave財報報喜！AI雲端股大反攻 分析師卻提醒一大風險
items.title_en: CoreWeave Reports Strong Earnings! AI Cloud Stocks Rally, but Analysts Warn of a Major Risk
paras: 據《路透》周三(11日)報導，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)強勁營收與融資策略調整，暫時緩解AI泡沫疑慮，股價上漲10%，帶動AI雲端股反彈。主要支持者輝達(NVDA-US)也漲5%，扭轉黃仁勳風波引發的連兩日跌勢。
CoreWeave上調全年營收預測，並表示，近期借款成本飆升後，將不再向無擔保債務市場籌資，現有合約產生的現金流足以支應當前及未來債務償付，回應市場對其舉債擴張的疑慮。
過去數周，投資人擔憂AI需求一旦放緩，仰賴負債擴建資料中心的業者將承受衝擊。民主黨上周期中選舉大勝，也增添監管變數，部分勝選者主張加強管制，甚至暫停新建資料中心，涵蓋德州等重要市場。
CoreWeave執行長Michael Intrator表示，審查趨嚴可能拖慢產業建設速度，但預期不會大幅改變公司擴張計畫或推升成本。
伯恩斯坦分析師Madison Rezaei團隊認為，這份財報幾乎符合最佳期待，營運數據強勁、融資疑慮獲得回應，策略也合理。不過，一旦AI算力供不應求的情況緩解，CoreWeave可能是最早且受創最重的業者之一。
投資時機錯配的風險已浮現。軟銀(9984-JP)周二針對美國資料中心設備的不可退還預付款認列37億美元減損，拖累第二季淨損達70億美元。
Nebius(NBIS-US)、Iren(IREN-US)、甲骨文(ORCL-US)及Applied Digital(APLD-US)盤前漲4.7%至11.8%。若漲勢維持，連同CoreWeave的雲端業者市值合計可望增加逾250億美元，輝達則約增2,100億美元。Nebius將於周四(12日)盤前公布財報。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Wednesday (the 11th), CoreWeave (CRWV-US) posted robust revenue and adjusted its financing strategy, temporarily easing concerns about an AI bubble. The stock rose 10%, sparking a rebound in AI cloud stocks. Its main backer Nvidia (NVDA-US) also gained 5%, reversing the two‑day decline triggered by the Jensen Huang controversy.

CoreWeave raised its full‑year revenue outlook and said that after a recent surge in borrowing costs it will no longer raise funds in the unsecured debt market. Cash flow from existing contracts is sufficient to cover current and future debt service, addressing market worries about debt‑driven expansion.

In recent weeks investors have feared that a slowdown in AI demand could hit companies that rely on debt‑financed data‑center builds. The Democrats’ big win in last week’s midterm elections adds regulatory uncertainty, as some winners are calling for tighter controls and even a pause on new data‑center construction in key markets such as Texas.
CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator said that tighter review could slow industry‑wide build‑out, but he does not expect it to materially alter the company’s expansion plans or drive up costs.

Bernstein analyst Madison Rezaei’s team believes the earnings almost met the best expectations, with strong operating metrics, financing concerns addressed, and a sensible strategy. However, if the shortage of AI compute power eases, CoreWeave could be one of the earliest and hardest‑hit players.

The risk of a timing mismatch in investment has already surfaced. SoftBank (9984-JP) on Tuesday recorded a $3.7 billion impairment on non‑refundable prepaid payments for U.S. data‑center equipment, dragging Q2 net loss to $7 billion.

Nebius (NBIS-US), Iren (IREN-US), Oracle (ORCL-US) and Applied Digital (APLD-US) were up 4.7% to 11.8% in pre‑market trading. If the rally holds, the combined market value of these cloud players plus CoreWeave could add more than $25 billion, while Nvidia could gain about $210 billion. Nebius will release its earnings in pre‑market trading on Thursday (the 12th).

items.title: 黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大！美國恐收緊輝達對中晶片出口管制、「3法案」通過機率飆升
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Affair Scandal Expands! U.S. Likely to Tighten Nvidia-China Chip Export Controls, "Three Bills" Passage Odds Surge
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳捲入婚外情及疑似中國情報人員相關風波，儘管輝達董事會已表態支持黃仁勳，美國國會跨黨派議員對他及輝達的信任卻出現動搖。分析指出，華府對此事的疑慮，預料將促使美國最快於下個月進一步收緊對輝達與中國業務往來的限制，國會議員也正準備舉行聽證會並展開調查。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，事實上，即使在間諜風波成為華府及華爾街焦點之前，針對中國取得部分輝達晶片的法案，就已經有機會透過年度國防法案在12月獲得國會通過。
多名分析師指出，如今這些法案透過這項「必須通過」的國防法案立法的可能性進一步提高。
Beacon Policy Advisors資深研究分析師Tedford指出，黃仁勳疑似涉及間諜事件，加上白宮承諾提出法案修正建議，使相關立法動能增強。不過，他認為法案仍非必然通過，即使最終獲得採納，內容也可能經過大幅調整，更接近白宮提出的版本。
目前受到關注的法案包括：

《晶片安全法案》（Chip Security Act），旨在遏止美國先進AI晶片遭非法走私至中國及其他敵對國家；
《AI監督法案》（AI Overwatch Act），則希望進一步收緊相關晶片的出口管制；
此外，《MATCH法案》也將針對敏感晶片製造設備加強出口限制。


報導指出，這些法案主要影響輝達，因為該公司掌握中國市場高度需求的最先進晶片。
上述三項法案都曾納入參議院今年稍早通過的國防授權法案版本，但未被眾議院版本採納。目前，參眾兩院協商代表正著手整合兩個版本的歧異，外界關注三項法案能否重新納入最終版本，讓國會兩院通過後，交由美國總統川普於下月簽署生效。
Veda Partners分析師Henrietta Treyz與Dan McCarthy指出，黃仁勳婚外情風波後，《晶片安全法案》立法機率已從原先的60%升至80%；《AI監督法案》從40%升至65%；《MATCH法案》則從35%提高至60%。
兩名分析師表示，接下來值得關注的是黃仁勳11月18日出席眾議院情報、外交事務及中國相關委員會閉門聽證會的情況，尤其是是否有證據顯示，川普政府的晶片與AI政策資訊曾洩漏給疑似中國情報人員、曾任新加坡雲端運算公司Megaspeed的高層黃樂（Alice Huang）。
至於川普政府是否進一步對輝達採取強硬措施，分析師認為可能性也有所上升，但幅度有限。最可能的做法是加強執法，打擊先進晶片走私至中國的行為。
另一種可能性較低的措施，是限制中國企業透過其他國家的資料中心遠端使用先進晶片。至於更激進的選項，包括撤銷輝達向中國出口H200晶片的許可，但分析師認為，考量川普與黃仁勳長期以來的關係，以及川普支持輝達發展的立場，短期內實施的可能性不高。
川普周一公開力挺黃仁勳，稱讚他「打造了一家很棒的公司」，並表示自己認為黃仁勳是非常正直的人，對他能妥善處理事件深具信心。川普也轉述，黃仁勳表示自己完全不知道相關人士是間諜。
輝達周日（8日）宣布，董事會正調查黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的鎖定目標。黃仁勳同日也在寄給員工的電子郵件中坦承對妻子不忠，並強調自己將致力於保護輝達及維護美國國家安全。
輝達股價周二（10日）下跌近6%，繼周一（9日）跌逾4%後持續走弱。今年以來股價累計下跌近10%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has become embroiled in an extramarital affair and alleged ties to Chinese intelligence operatives. Although Nvidia's board has voiced support for Huang, bipartisan members of the U.S. Congress are wavering in their trust of him and the company. Analysts say Washington's concerns are expected to prompt the United States to further tighten restrictions on Nvidia's dealings with China as early as next month, with lawmakers preparing hearings and investigations.

According to MarketWatch, even before the espionage scandal became a focus in Washington and on Wall Street, legislation aimed at restricting China's acquisition of certain Nvidia chips had a chance to pass Congress through the annual defense bill in December.
Several analysts note that the likelihood of these bills being enacted as part of the "must‑pass" defense legislation has now increased further.

Tedford, a senior research analyst at Beacon Policy Advisors, said Huang's alleged involvement in an espionage incident, combined with the White House's pledge to propose amendments, has boosted legislative momentum. However, he cautioned that the bills are not guaranteed to pass and, even if adopted, could be substantially revised to align more closely with the White House's version.
The bills currently under scrutiny include:

The Chip Security Act, which aims to prevent advanced U.S. AI chips from being illegally smuggled to China and other hostile nations; the AI Overwatch Act, which seeks to tighten export controls on related chips; and the MATCH Act, which would tighten export restrictions on sensitive chip‑manufacturing equipment. The report notes that these measures primarily affect Nvidia, which holds the most advanced chips that are in high demand in the Chinese market.

All three proposals were incorporated into the version of the defense authorization bill that the Senate passed earlier this year, but were omitted from the House version. Lawmakers from both chambers are now working to reconcile the differences, and observers are watching to see whether the three bills will be re‑included in the final package that, if passed by both chambers, would be sent to President Trump for signing next month.

Veda Partners analysts Henrietta Treyz and Dan McCarthy said that after the affair scandal, the probability of the Chip Security Act being enacted rose from 60% to 80%; the AI Overwatch Act from 40% to 65%; and the MATCH Act from 35% to 60%.

The analysts added that attention will now turn to Huang's closed‑door testimony before the House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs and China committees on November 18, particularly whether evidence emerges that Trump administration chip and AI policy information was leaked to suspected Chinese intelligence operatives, including former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang.

As for whether the Trump administration will take tougher action against Nvidia, analysts say the likelihood has risen but any measures would be limited. The most probable step is increased enforcement to curb the smuggling of advanced chips to China.

A less likely option would be to restrict Chinese firms from remotely accessing advanced chips via data centers in other countries. A more aggressive possibility would be to revoke Nvidia's license to export H200 chips to China, but analysts note that, given Trump’s long‑standing relationship with Huang and his support for Nvidia’s growth, such a move is unlikely in the short term.

Trump publicly defended Huang on Monday, praising him for "building a great company" and saying he considers Huang a very upright person and is confident he can handle the situation properly. Trump also relayed that Huang said he had no knowledge that the individuals involved were spies.

Nvidia announced on Sunday (the 8th) that its board is investigating whether Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations. In an email to employees the same day, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and emphasized his commitment to protecting Nvidia and safeguarding U.S. national security.
Nvidia's shares fell nearly 6% on Tuesday (the 10th), extending a decline that saw the stock drop more than 4% on Monday (the 9th). The stock is down almost 10% year‑to‑date.

items.title_en: AI Data Centers Boost Power Equipment Demand; Siemens Energy’s Full-Year Net Profit Grows 1.5‑Fold, Orders Hit Record High
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨著AI資料中心持續擴建，全球發電及輸配電設備需求增加。德國能源設備大廠西門子能源Siemens Energy(ENR-DE)公布截至2026年9月底的全年財報，淨利達41.29億歐元（約新台幣1,515億元），較前一年度增加約1.5倍，全年營收達442.43億歐元（約新台幣1.62兆元）。公司在手訂單更創下1,640億歐元新高，為未來數年營運提供支撐。
西門子能源2026會計年度營收年增16%，全年在手訂單達1,640億歐元（約新台幣6.02兆元），較前一年度增加18%。其中，燃氣渦輪機及電網設備業務成長最為明顯，成為公司營收與獲利改善的主要來源。
這波成長與全球電力基礎建設投資增加有關。AI資料中心需要大量且穩定的電力供應，帶動天然氣發電設備、變壓器及輸配電系統採購需求。除了資料中心，電動車普及與電力需求增加，也促使各國持續投資電網及新增發電容量。對西門子能源而言，需求不只來自新建電廠，也包括將新增電力輸送至用電端所需的電網設備。
執行長Christian Bruch於今日表示，全球用電需求明顯增加，發電與輸配電基礎建設都需要大規模投資。公司旗下燃氣渦輪機及電網設備業務持續成長，風力發電業務的獲利也逐步改善，減輕過去風電業務虧損對集團的拖累。
展望2027會計年度，西門子能源預估營收將再成長14%至16%，淨利最高達50億歐元（約新台幣1,835億元），較2026會計年度增加約21%。公司並預期至2030年，營收年均成長率將達12%至14%，天然氣發電及輸配電設備仍是主要成長來源。
為集中資源投入成長較快的業務，西門子能源已於今年8月宣布，計畫將包括蒸汽渦輪機在內的部分工業設備業務分拆，並出售多數持股，使相關業務不再納入合併財報。由於這些產品主要供應一般工業及工廠客戶，與集團其他業務的整合效益有限，公司希望透過調整業務組合，將更多資源投入天然氣發電及輸配電設備。

paras_en: November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – As AI data centers continue to expand, global demand for power generation and transmission equipment is rising. German power‑equipment giant Siemens Energy (ENR.DE) reported full‑year results through the end of September 2026, posting net profit of €4.129 billion (about NT$151.5 billion), roughly 1.5 times the prior year, and revenue of €44.243 billion (about NT$1.62 trillion). The company’s order backlog also reached a new high of €164 billion, supporting operations for the coming years.

Siemens Energy’s 2026 fiscal year revenue grew 16% year‑on‑year, with the order backlog reaching €164 billion (about NT$6.02 trillion), an 18% increase over the previous year. Growth was strongest in the gas turbine and grid‑equipment businesses, which drove the improvement in revenue and profit.

This growth is linked to rising global investment in power infrastructure. AI data centers require large, stable power supplies, spurring demand for gas‑fired generation equipment, transformers and transmission‑distribution systems. In addition to data centers, the proliferation of electric vehicles and higher electricity consumption are prompting countries to keep investing in grids and new generation capacity. For Siemens Energy, demand comes not only from new power plants but also from the grid equipment needed to deliver the additional electricity to end users.

Chief Executive Christian Bruch said today that global electricity demand is clearly rising, and both generation and transmission‑distribution infrastructure will need massive investment. The company’s gas turbine and grid‑equipment businesses continue to grow, and profitability in the wind‑power segment is gradually improving, easing the drag from past wind‑business losses on the group.

Looking ahead to the 2027 fiscal year, Siemens Energy forecasts revenue to grow another 14%‑16% and net profit to reach up to €5.0 billion (about NT$1.835 billion), roughly a 21% increase over 2026. The company also expects an annual revenue growth rate of 12%‑14% through 2030, with gas‑fired generation and transmission‑distribution equipment remaining the main growth drivers.

To focus resources on faster‑growing businesses, Siemens Energy announced in August that it will spin off part of its industrial equipment business, including steam turbines, and sell most of its stake, removing those operations from the consolidated financial statements. Because these products mainly serve general industry and factory customers and offer limited synergies with the rest of the group, the company aims to reallocate resources toward gas‑fired generation and transmission‑distribution equipment.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher / CoreWeave Jumps 13% Leading AI Stock Rebound, Nasdaq Up 1.6%
paras: 2026年11月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股11日開盤走高，AI雲端運算業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)公布優於預期的第三季財報，並上調全年營收及營業利益財測，緩解市場對AI基礎建設投資回收的疑慮。CoreWeave開盤後大漲13%，帶動科技股反彈，那斯達克綜合指數上漲1.6%，標普500指數上漲近1%，道瓊工業指數則小漲45點，漲幅約0.1%。
CoreWeave近期成為市場檢視AI投資效益的重要指標。這家公司透過舉債擴建GPU運算基礎設施，再將算力提供給AI企業與雲端客戶使用。隨著市場開始擔心資料中心建置進度放緩，以及龐大資本支出何時能轉為獲利，CoreWeave股價先前承受明顯賣壓。不過，最新財報營收優於分析師預期，公司也提高2026年營收與營業利益展望，並預期2028年上半年可達成調整後獲利，讓市場重新評估其成長前景。
投資市場對AI投資的態度已從過去普遍看好資本支出增加，轉向更重視實際投資報酬。CoreWeave先前正是這波疑慮下的代表性個股，而最新財報與獲利展望暫時減輕市場擔憂，也為近期跌深的AI基礎建設類股帶來反彈機會。
輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)開盤後上漲約3%，扭轉本週前兩個交易日累計近10%的跌幅，有助於減輕大型科技股賣壓。

AI基礎建設相關股票在盤前已率先反彈，其中Nebius Group(NBIS-US)一度上漲13.9%，Applied Digital(APLD-US)上漲10.1%；半導體業者邁威爾Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)、美光Micron(MU-US)則分別上漲9.1%及7.4%。儲存設備業者希捷Seagate Technology(STX-US)及威騰電子Western Digital(WDC-US)盤前漲幅也達9.5%及8.6%，顯示資金回流範圍涵蓋雲端運算、晶片及資料儲存供應鏈。
不過，科技股反彈之際，美國通膨與升息壓力仍未解除。美國10月消費者物價指數（CPI）月增0.4%，高於市場預期的0.3%，使投資人更加確信聯準會將於12月升息。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場預估12月升息1碼的機率已提高至約90%，利率前景仍可能影響科技股評價，以及高度依賴外部融資的資料中心業者。

paras_en: On November 11, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. equities opened higher on the 11th. AI cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) posted a third‑quarter earnings report that beat expectations and raised its full‑year revenue and operating‑income forecasts, easing market concerns about the payback of AI infrastructure investments. CoreWeave surged 13% after the open, pulling tech stocks higher; the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.6%, the S&P 500 climbed nearly 1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average inched up about 45 points, roughly 0.1%.

CoreWeave has recently become a key barometer for assessing AI investment returns. The company finances the expansion of GPU‑compute infrastructure through debt and then sells compute capacity to AI firms and cloud customers. As the market began to worry about a slowdown in data‑center build‑out and when large capital outlays might turn profitable, CoreWeave’s share price had been under clear selling pressure. However, the latest earnings showed revenue above analysts’ estimates, and the company lifted its 2026 revenue and operating‑income outlook, also projecting adjusted profitability by the first half of 2028, prompting the market to re‑evaluate its growth prospects.

Investors’ attitude toward AI spending has shifted from a broad optimism about rising capex to a stronger focus on actual investment returns. CoreWeave was a representative stock of the earlier wave of doubt, and the new earnings and profit outlook have temporarily eased market concerns, offering a rebound opportunity for AI‑infrastructure stocks that have recently fallen deep.
NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) rose about 3% after the open, reversing nearly 10% of the losses accumulated over the previous two trading days, helping to relieve selling pressure on large‑cap tech stocks.

AI‑infrastructure‑related stocks were already bouncing in pre‑market trading: Nebius Group (NBIS‑US) at one point jumped 13.9%, Applied Digital (APLD‑US) rose 10.1%; semiconductor makers Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) climbed 9.1% and 7.4% respectively. Storage‑equipment companies Seagate Technology (STX‑US) and Western Digital (WDC‑US) were also up 9.5% and 8.6% in pre‑market, showing that capital is flowing back across the cloud‑computing, chip and data‑storage supply chain.

Nevertheless, as tech stocks rebound, U.S. inflation and rate‑hike pressures remain unresolved. October’s U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above the 0.3% market expectation, reinforcing investors’ belief that the Federal Reserve will raise rates in December. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of a one‑basis‑point rate hike in December has risen to about 90%, and the interest‑rate outlook could still affect tech‑stock valuations and data‑center operators that rely heavily on external financing.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the “single currency law package” by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate the process to ensure the overall preparation work has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on 10 November, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that “Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different.” He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s reliance on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: “It will be a complementary means to cash, never a replacement.”

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data protection, transaction fee structures and individual holding limits.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Resurge, Yen Falls to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Barrier
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak performance in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday, marking a new low of about one and a half months since late September.

Market analysis points out that U.S. CPI data that came in above expectations sparked expectations of Fed rate hikes, causing U.S. Treasury yields to surge and widening the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, attracting carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, further pushing the yen lower.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have made hawkish remarks, also providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said before the inflation data release that if core inflation hits 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider evaluating a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) rate hike next month. After the data were released, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that stronger inflation might require a faster pace of hikes; Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee was even more blunt, calling the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata, an economist at the First Life Economic Research Institute, offered a different view. Katsurahata believes the market’s speculation that the Fed will raise rates by 2 points in December is an overreaction; as the market pricing settles at a 1‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is expected to be limited.

At the same time, analysts think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to prevent further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show that policymakers remain highly vigilant about inflation upside risks and support taking additional tightening measures. Affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark government bond yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued depreciation boosts the profitability of Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials have significantly increased corporate burdens and sparked domestic consumer price pressures.

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”

items.title: 伊朗威脅行動升級！紐時：對伊極限經濟戰引火上身  貝森特搬進軍事基地避險
items.title_en: Iran Threatens to Escalate Actions! NYT: Extreme Economic War on Iran Backfires, Berrens Moves to Military Base for Safety
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，主導對伊朗制裁的美國財長貝森特已搬入軍事基地，因美方官員認為伊朗針對美國現任及前任官員的行動正進入更深入階段。
《紐約時報》引述三位知情人士報導，美國財長貝森特因自8月起主導川普政府對伊朗的極限經濟施壓，成為德黑蘭重點打擊目標，目前已離開華府住所，轉入軍事基地保護。貝森特透過加強制裁與限制貿易路線，試圖切斷伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊的資金來源。
美國財政部發言人強調，他不會因威脅退縮，官員坦言尚不清楚針對貝森特的威脅有多嚴重，但伊朗過往針對特定個人的威脅常有具體行動指向。
報導指出，去年至少6位美國高官也採取類似措施，像是白宮辦公廳主任米勒等，部分威脅甚至與委內瑞拉局勢有關。威脅蔓延也促使美國調整海外部署。美國國務院上月要求中東地區雇員提升警戒並縮編使領館，因懷疑英國一處軍事基地面臨恐攻陰謀，美軍緊急撤走轟炸機。
這場安全風暴根源於2020年美軍擊殺伊朗將領蘇萊曼尼，伊朗隨後將川普列為報復目標。2024年，美國起訴一名伊朗革命衛隊人員涉嫌策劃謀殺川普。拜登政府曾為當年行動團隊成員提供保護，但川普重返白宮後撤銷了這些安排。
川普政府希望透過經濟制裁迫使德黑蘭讓步，避免重啟大規模軍事行動。儘管伊朗經濟萎縮、貨幣貶值，但情報顯示其強硬派決心不惜代價維持政權，單靠施壓能否改變立場仍是未知數。從貝森特轉入基地到中東人員縮編，伊朗的威脅正深刻影響美國各層面的安全佈局。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that U.S. Treasury Secretary Berrens, who leads sanctions against Iran, has moved into a military base because U.S. officials say Iran’s actions against current and former U.S. officials are entering a deeper phase.

The New York Times, citing three insiders, reported that Treasury Secretary Berrens, who has been spearheading the Trump administration’s extreme economic pressure on Iran since August, has become a primary target for Tehran and has left his Washington residence for protection at a military base. Berrens is trying to cut off funding to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps by tightening sanctions and restricting trade routes.

A Treasury Department spokesperson stressed that he will not back down in the face of threats; officials admitted they do not yet know how serious the threat to Berrens is, but noted that Iran’s past threats against specific individuals have often been accompanied by concrete actions.

The report notes that at least six senior U.S. officials took similar steps last year, such as White House Office of Management and Budget director Miller, with some threats linked to the situation in Venezuela. The spreading threats have also prompted the United States to adjust overseas deployments. Last month the State Department ordered Middle‑East staff to increase alert levels and downsize embassies after suspecting a British military base of being the target of a terror plot, prompting U.S. forces to urgently withdraw bombers.

The security storm stems from the 2020 U.S. strike that killed Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani, after which Iran named former President Trump as a retaliation target. In 2024 the United States indicted an IRGC member for allegedly plotting to assassinate Trump. The Biden administration had provided protection for members of the original operation team, but those arrangements were cancelled after Trump returned to the White House.

The Trump administration hoped that economic sanctions would force Tehran to concede and avoid a large‑scale military restart. Although Iran’s economy has contracted and its currency has depreciated, intelligence shows hardliners remain determined to preserve the regime at any cost, leaving it uncertain whether pressure alone can shift their stance. From Berrens’s move to a base to the downsizing of Middle‑East staff, Iran’s threat is profoundly reshaping U.S. security planning across the board.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: US CPI Hot, Fed Governor’s Hawkish Remarks Strengthen Rate‑Hike Expectations, Dollar Rises
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周二(10日)攀高，美國通膨數據比預期火熱，強化了聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.57%，報102.26。
歐元兌美元下跌0.55%，報1.116美元。美元兌日元上漲0.55%，報158.80日元。元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.71%，報0.8252瑞郎。
美國勞工部公布的數據顯示，美國10月消費者物價指數(CPI)月增0.4%，高於經濟學家預估的月增0.3%。
數據公布後，美元兌一籃子貨幣延續漲勢。通常與Fed利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率也大幅跳升，最新上漲18.44個基點至4.731%。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered Bank) G10外匯研究及北美總體策略全球主管Steve Englander表示，市場對這份數據感到措手不及，因為數據似乎支持Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周二發表的鷹派談話。華勒當時表示，Fed應在下個月升息，以提高短期借貸成本。
Englander說：「華勒的談話如此鷹派，引起市場注意。美元和利率的這波漲勢就是從那時開始的。」
他表示：「CPI數據也偏熱，尤其是通膨似乎相當廣泛，因此市場開始感到擔憂。美國11月3日期中選舉以來，美元走勢大多受到油價交易主導，但現在市場人士開始認為：『我們是不是看錯了重點？真正應該關注的是通膨風險，以及Fed的政策動向。』」
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場目前預估Fed 12月升息的機率接近91%。
對貿易情勢與市場情緒較為敏感的澳幣兌美元下跌0.89%，報0.686美元。紐元兌美元下跌0.56%，報0.56美元。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta說：「短期內美元走弱的空間仍然有限。勞動市場展現韌性，加上國內經濟活動穩健，持續支撐美國消費，也降低經濟突然放緩的風險，很難看到年底前持續走貶。」

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Tuesday (the 10th), as US inflation data came in hotter than expected, bolstering the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.57% to 102.26.
The euro fell 0.55% against the dollar to $1.116, the dollar rose 0.55% against the yen to ¥158.80, and the euro gained 0.71% against the Swiss franc to CHF 0.8252.
US Labor Department data showed that the US consumer price index (CPI) for October rose 0.4% month‑over‑month, above economists’ forecast of a 0.3% increase.

After the release, the dollar continued its rally against a basket of currencies. The US 2‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves in line with Fed rate expectations, jumped sharply, up 18.44 basis points to 4.731%.

Steve Englander, Global Head of G10 FX Research and North America Macro Strategy at Standard Chartered Bank, said the market was caught off guard by the data because it seemed to support Fed Governor Christopher Waller’s hawkish comments on Tuesday. Waller said the Fed should raise rates next month to lift short‑term borrowing costs.
Englander said, “Waller’s remarks were so hawkish that they grabbed market attention. The dollar and rate rally started from that point.”

He added, “The CPI data was also on the hotter side, especially since inflation appears fairly broad‑based, so the market began to worry. Since the US mid‑term elections on November 3, the dollar’s moves have been largely driven by oil‑price trading, but now market participants are thinking: ‘Did we miss the point? The real focus should be on inflation risk and Fed policy direction.’”
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now estimates a roughly 91% chance of a Fed rate hike in December.
The Australian dollar, which is sensitive to trade conditions and market sentiment, fell 0.89% against the dollar to $0.686, while the New Zealand dollar slipped 0.56% to $0.56.

Karl Schamotta, Chief Market Strategist at Corpay, said, “The short‑term upside for a weaker dollar is still limited. A resilient labour market, together with solid domestic economic activity that continues to support US consumption, reduces the risk of a sudden slowdown, making it hard to see a sustained decline before year‑end.”

items.title: 日本央行會議紀錄顯露鷹派訊號 多位委員支持加快升息至中立利率
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Meeting Minutes Reveal Hawkish Signals, Several Governors Back Faster Rate Hikes to Neutral Level
paras: 日本央行於10月29至30日召開貨幣政策會議，決議將政策利率維持在1.25%的30年高位，但最新公布的「主要意見」摘要顯示，多名審議委員對早期升息展現積極態度。
在會議表決中，被視為鷹派的審議委員高田創提出將利率調升至1.5%左右的提案，雖遭多數否決，而在9月反對升息的淺田統一郎與佐藤綾野兩位委員，本次投票贊成維持現狀。
針對未來貨幣政策走向，日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會上強調，包含12月會議在內，每次會議都會評估是否升息，並指出基調物價通膨率已達到2%的政策目標。
會議紀錄中，有委員主張「不應過度謹慎，應在可行時實施升息」，也有委員表示日本經濟已進入「需加快腳步將政策利率推升至中立利率」的新階段。
一名委員指出，由於先前的升息，寬鬆程度已逐步降低。他補充說，政策利率目前處於日本央行估計的中性利率區間(1.1%-2.5%)內，但應注意未來升息可能抑制經濟成長和潛在通膨的風險。此外，多名委員指出當前金融環境仍屬寬鬆，應在數個月內確認金融情勢後「悠然但迅速」地調整政策。
隨著核心物價穩定成長，金融市場與利率掉期交易預估，日銀於12月再次升息25個基點的機率已高達七至八成。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan held its monetary policy meeting on October 29‑30, deciding to keep the policy rate at a 30‑year high of 1.25%, but the newly released summary of the "Main Opinions" shows that several board members were proactive about earlier rate hikes.

In the vote, hawkish board member Takada Hajime proposed raising the rate to around 1.5%, a motion that was largely rejected, while the two members who opposed a hike in September, Shimada Kazuo and Sato Ayano, voted to maintain the status quo this time.

Regarding the future path of monetary policy, BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo stressed at the post‑meeting press conference that each meeting, including the December session, will assess whether to raise rates, noting that core‑inflation has already hit the 2% target.

The minutes record that some members argued "we should not be overly cautious and should raise rates when feasible," while others said Japan’s economy has entered a new phase "that requires accelerating the push to lift the policy rate to a neutral level."

One member pointed out that, because of previous hikes, the degree of monetary easing has already been gradually reduced. He added that the policy rate now sits within the BOJ’s estimated neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%, but warned that further hikes could curb growth and potential inflation. Several members also noted that the financial environment remains accommodative and that policy should be adjusted "calmly but swiftly" within a few months after confirming financial conditions.
With core prices showing stable growth, financial markets and interest‑rate swap traders estimate a 70‑80% chance that the BOJ will raise rates by another 25 basis points in December.

items.title: 日元明年走勢兩極化！彭博前季預測冠軍估貶170 最新冠軍看升147
items.title_en: Yen's Outlook Next Year Splits: Bloomberg's Prior Quarter Champion Forecasts a 170 Decline, New Champion Sees a 147 Rise
paras: 在歷經多次金融危機與劇烈的匯率波動後，深耕日元市場近30年的外匯專家奈爾·帕克（Neil Parker）再次拋出震撼彈。根據彭博最新的外匯預測排名，這位日元兌美元預測準確率居冠的策略師認為，隨著美日利差逐步收窄，日元明年有望強勁反彈至 147 兌 1 美元。
在看法高度分歧的市場中，帕克屬於最樂觀的陣營之一。他預期日元年底前將升至155日元兌1美元左右，之後進一步走強；上季度的彭博預測冠軍看法則截然相反，認為日元明年將一路走貶至 170 大關。
造成市場預測極端分歧的核心原因，在於對日本央行（BOJ）升息路徑的判斷差異。
帕克預估日本央行將把基準利率從 1.25% 一路調升至至少 2%，甚至上看 2.25%，其緊縮立場遠比市場主流預期更為激進；至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
至於美國聯準會（Fed），他則預期 12 月可能再升息一次，最終將政策利率凍結在 4.00% 至 4.25% 區間。
擔任外匯與支付公司TTT Moneycorp經濟暨市場策略主管的帕克表示：「日本可能成為少數例外，日本銀行確實會履行承諾，將利率調整至與通膨相符的水準。」
日本市場人士對於通膨升溫是否會促使央行加快緊縮，仍存在分歧。日本9月扣除生鮮食品與能源的消費者物價指數年增2.4%，這也是日本銀行密切關注、用來衡量底層通膨的指標。
帕克表示，若增幅升至2.6%或更高，可能促使央行採取更強力措施，加快緊縮步調。不過，他也不確定日本銀行是否會最快在12月就採取行動。
日美緊縮步調的差異，是他預測日元走強的基礎。他表示，兩國利差若再縮小約50個基點，也就是他預期明年年中至下半年可能出現的幅度，或許就足以促使投資人重新調整預期。
他說：「投資人不一定要加碼日本資產，只要降低減碼幅度就夠了。」
日元今年平均匯率約為158日元兌1美元，7月一度貶至163.99，隨後日本與美國當局出手干預。市場劇烈波動考驗著派克的預測，但除非支撐其判斷的經濟基本面改變，否則他不願輕易調整展望。
在建構預測模型時，帕克會將市場對利率與通漲的預期與自身研判進行對照，從中尋找價格錯置所產生的匯率波段機會。
他透露其獨門心法在於摒除過多市場噪音，僅專注於少數關鍵的總體經濟指標，而非過度解讀各國央行官員的發言或隨市場情緒起舞。
運用類似方法，派克也在彭博歐元兌日元預測排名中奪冠，不過他坦言，這項成績也受惠於長期對歐洲經濟抱持悲觀看法，以及一些運氣。
他表示：「從某些方面來說，歐元兌日元的預測比美元兌日元多了些運氣成分。」
他指出，歐洲大幅降息，加上經濟缺乏韌性，使他對歐元持悲觀看法。「至於美元兌日元，我認為更能依循總體經濟因素來判斷。」
帕克於1995年踏入金融市場，數十年來持續追蹤日元及其他主要貨幣。根據他的LinkedIn個人資料，他於2025年加入總部位於倫敦的TTT Moneycorp。這家外匯與支付公司也在彭博最新的歐元兌美元及美元兌瑞士法郎預測排名中居冠。
帕克表示，職涯早期的日元走勢與總體經濟關聯更密切，當時較容易預測。不過，他並不認為如今的日元特別難以預測，因為日本央行對數據的反應更加敏銳，尤其是通膨數據。
他最後強調，外匯預測的本質不在於憑空研判走勢的終點，而是精確捉摸自身觀點與市場大盤預期之間的相對落差。
paras_en: After weathering multiple financial crises and sharp exchange‑rate swings, Neil Parker, a foreign‑exchange specialist who has been deep‑rooted in the yen market for nearly 30 years, has again dropped a bombshell. According to Bloomberg's latest FX forecast rankings, the strategist with the highest accuracy in predicting USD/JPY believes that as the US‑Japan rate differential narrows, the yen could rebound strongly to 147 per dollar next year.

In a market where views are sharply divided, Parker is among the most optimistic camp. He expects the yen to climb to around 155 per dollar by year‑end and then strengthen further; Bloomberg’s previous quarter champion, by contrast, predicted the yen would slide all the way to the 170 level next year.
The core reason for the extreme split in market forecasts lies in differing judgments about the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate‑hiking path.

Parker projects the BOJ will raise its policy rate from 1.25% up to at least 2%, possibly as high as 2.25%, a tightening stance far more aggressive than mainstream market expectations; regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.
Regarding the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed), he foresees a possible rate hike in December, ultimately freezing policy rates in the 4.00%‑4.25% range.

Parker, who serves as Head of Economic and Market Strategy at foreign‑exchange and payments firm TTT Moneycorp, said, "Japan may be one of the few exceptions; the BOJ will indeed honor its commitment and adjust rates to a level consistent with inflation."

Market participants in Japan remain split on whether rising inflation will prompt the central bank to accelerate tightening. Japan’s core CPI (excluding fresh food and energy) rose 2.4% year‑over‑year in September, a key gauge the BOJ watches closely to assess underlying inflation.
Parker noted that if the increase reaches 2.6% or higher, it could push the BOJ to take stronger action and speed up tightening, though he is unsure whether the bank will act as early as December.

The divergence in tightening pace between the U.S. and Japan underpins his yen‑strength forecast. He says a further narrowing of the interest‑rate gap by about 50 basis points – the magnitude he expects around mid‑to‑late next year – could be enough to make investors revise their expectations.
He added, "Investors don’t necessarily need to increase exposure to Japanese assets; simply reducing the pace of de‑risking is sufficient."

The yen’s average rate this year has been about 158 per dollar, slipping to 163.99 in July before Japanese and U.S. authorities intervened. Market volatility tests Parker’s forecast, but unless the underlying economic fundamentals that support his view change, he is reluctant to alter his outlook.
When building his forecast model, Parker compares market expectations for rates and inflation with his own analysis, seeking price dislocations that create exchange‑rate swing opportunities.
He revealed his secret lies in filtering out excessive market noise and focusing on a handful of key macro indicators, rather than over‑interpreting central‑bank speeches or chasing market sentiment.
Using a similar approach, Parker also topped Bloomberg’s EUR/JPY forecast rankings, though he admits that result was helped by a long‑standing bearish view on Europe’s economy and a bit of luck.
He said, "In some respects, the EUR/JPY forecast involved more luck than the USD/JPY one."

He pointed out that Europe’s deep rate cuts and a lack of economic resilience have made him bearish on the euro. "As for USD/JPY, I think it can be judged more directly by macro fundamentals," he added.

Parker entered the financial markets in 1995 and has tracked the yen and other major currencies for decades. According to his LinkedIn profile, he joined London‑based TTT Moneycorp in 2025. The firm also leads Bloomberg’s latest forecast rankings for EUR/USD and USD/CHF.

Parker said his early‑career yen moves were more closely tied to macro fundamentals and therefore easier to predict. He does not think the yen is especially harder to forecast today, as the BOJ now reacts more sharply to data, especially inflation figures.

He concluded that the essence of FX forecasting is not to guess the ultimate direction out of thin air, but to precisely gauge the relative gap between one’s own view and the broader market consensus.
